commission.chinese: 政府成立了一个委员会调查对警察施暴行为的指控。

commission.english: a commission from the Academy for a new sculpture
commission.chinese: 学院要求制作一尊新雕塑的委托

commit.english: Women commit fewer crimes than men.

commitment.english: Are you ready to make a long-term commitment ?
commitment.chinese: 你是否准备好作出长久的承诺？

common.english: Heart disease is one of the commonest causes of death.
common.chinese: 心脏病是最常见的死因之一。

commonly.english: Sodium chloride is more commonly known as salt.

commonplace.english: It is a commonplace to say that Northern Ireland is a backwater in the modern Europe.
commonplace.chinese: 说北爱尔兰是现代欧洲死气沉沉的落后地区已是陈词滥调了。

commonplace.english: Car thefts are commonplace in this part of town.
commonplace.chinese: 镇上的这个地段盗车案屡见不鲜。

commonsense.english: The judge's ruling was based on the simple commonsense tenet that no man is above the law.
commonsense.chinese: 法官的判决基于一个常识性原则，即谁也不能凌驾于法律之上。

communicate.english: A baby communicates its needs by crying.

communication.english: Good communication is vital in a large organization.
communication.chinese: 在大机构里良好的沟通是极为重要的。

communication.english: Radio was the pilot’s only means of communication .
communication.chinese: 无线电是飞行员唯一的通信手段。

communist.english: Without the communists in France, the resistance might not have succeeded in World War II.
communist.chinese: 如果没有法国的共产主义者，二战中的抵抗运动可能不会成功。

community.english: The new arts centre will serve the whole community.
community.chinese: 这座新的艺术中心将为整个社区服务。

commute.english: Baldry’s 20-year prison sentence was commuted to three years.
commute.chinese: 鲍德里二十年的刑期被减至三年。

compact.english: The students’ rooms were compact, with a desk, bed, and closet built in.
compact.chinese: 学生的房间很小巧，配有一张书桌、一张床和一个壁橱。

compact.english: The compact design of the machine allows it to be stored easily.
compact.chinese: 这台机器的设计小巧灵便，易于存放。

companion.english: For ten years he had been her constant companion .
companion.chinese: 十年来他一直陪伴她左右。

companion.english: His dog became his closest companion .
companion.chinese: 他的狗成了他最亲密的伙伴。

company.english: The company directors have awarded themselves a massive pay increase.
company.chinese: 公司的董事们给自己大幅加薪。

company.english: I called the phone company about the bill.
company.chinese: 我就电话账单的事给电话公司打了电话。

comparable.english: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.
comparable.chinese: 同样大小的汽车在国外要贵得多。

comparative.english: She didn’t want to leave the comparative safety of the shelter.
comparative.chinese: 她不愿离开相对来说还算安全的掩蔽处。

comparative.english: After a lifetime of poverty, his last few years were spent in comparable comfort.
comparative.chinese: 他穷了一辈子，最后几年还算过得比较舒适。

compare.english: The report compares the different types of home computer available.
compare.chinese: 这份报告比较了市场上不同类型的家用计算机。

comparison.english: Her paintings invite comparison with those of the early Impressionists (= they remind you of them ) .
comparison.chinese: 她的画作让人想起早期的印象派作品。

compartment.english: She kept the money hidden in a secret compartment in her briefcase.
compartment.chinese: 她把钱藏在公文包的暗层里。

compartment.english: The bag is divided into separate compartments .
compartment.chinese: 这个包有一些独立的隔层。

compassion.english: I was shocked by the doctor’s lack of compassion .
compassion.chinese: 我对这个医生如此缺乏同情心感到震惊。

compatible.english: The new software is IBM compatible (= can be used with IBM computers ) .
compatible.chinese: 这个新软件与IBM的计算机兼容。

compelling.english: His life makes a compelling story .
compelling.chinese: 他的一生是个引人入胜的故事。

compensate.english: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
compensate.chinese: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

compensate.english: The firm will compensate workers for their loss of earnings.
compensate.chinese: 公司将补偿工人的收入损失。

compensation.english: People who are wrongly arrested may be paid compensation .
compensation.chinese: 被误抓的人有可能得到补偿费。

compete.chinese: 我：你的“竞争”是什么意思？

compete.english: The banks have long competed with American Express's charge cards and various shop cards.
compete.chinese: 这些银行长期以来一直与美国运通公司的记账卡和各种商店卡竞争。

competence.english: Typing is considered by most employers to be a basic competence.
competence.chinese: 大多数雇主认为打字是一项基本技能。

competent.english: A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem.
competent.chinese: 一名合格的机修工应该能够解决这个问题。

competition.english: Going to trade fairs is an ideal opportunity to size up the competition .
competition.chinese: 参加商品交易会是估量竞争规模的理想机会。

competitive.english: Some US industries are not as competitive as they have been in the past.
competitive.chinese: 美国有些行业不如以前有竞争力了。

competitive.english: Competitive sports encourage children to work together as a team.
competitive.chinese: 竞技体育鼓励孩子们进行团队协作。

competitiveness.english: New machinery has enhanced the company’s productivity and competitiveness.
competitiveness.chinese: 新机器帮助公司提高了生产力，增强了竞争力。

competitor.english: Last year they sold twice as many computers as their competitors.
competitor.chinese: 去年他们的计算机销量是竞争对手的两倍。

compile.english: The document was compiled by the Department of Health.
compile.chinese: 这份文件是由卫生部汇编的。

complacency.english: Doctors have warned against complacency in fighting common diseases.
complacency.chinese: 医生警告说，治疗常见病不能一见好就掉以轻心。

complacency.english: Despite yesterday’s win, there is clearly no room for complacency if the team want to stay top of the league.
complacency.chinese: 尽管这支球队昨天赢了，但要在联赛中独占鳌头，就不能骄傲自满。

complain.english: I shouldn't complain, I've got a good job to go back to.
complain.chinese: 我不该抱怨，我已有可回去干的一份好工作。

complain.english: Residents are complaining because traffic in the area has increased.
complain.chinese: 由于这个地区的交通流量有所增加，居民都在抱怨。

complaint.english: If you wish to make a complaint, you should see the manager.
complaint.chinese: 如果你要投诉，应该去找经理。

complaint.english: He is having treatment for a chest complaint.
complaint.chinese: 他在接受胸部疾病的治疗。

complement.english: The green wallpaper is the perfect complement to the old pine of the dresser.
complement.chinese: 绿色墙纸是旧松木梳妆台的完美衬托。

complement.english: This wine would be a nice complement to grilled dishes.
complement.chinese: 这种葡萄酒配烧烤食物会很不错。

complete.english: The police were in complete control of the situation.
complete.chinese: 警方已完全控制了局势。

complete.english: Their engagement came as a complete surprise to me.
complete.chinese: 他们的订婚让我感到非常意外。

completely.english: Portuguese is pronounced completely differently from Spanish.
completely.chinese: 葡萄牙语的发音和西班牙语的完全不同。

completely.english: He had never completely recovered from his illness.
completely.chinese: 他病后一直没有完全康复。

completion.english: The project has a completion date of December 22nd.
completion.chinese: 该项目的完成日期是12月22日。

completion.english: The house is nearing completion (= almost finished ) .

complex.english: Peter seemed to have an instant understanding of the most complex issues.
complex.chinese: 再复杂的问题彼得似乎也是一看就明白。

complex.english: It was a very complex relationship between two complex people.
complex.chinese: 这是两个复杂的人之间非常复杂的关系。

complexion.english: Drinking water is good for the complexion.

complicate.english: If the answer to all of these questions is no, a framework will only complicate matters.
complicate.chinese: 如果所有这些问题的答案都为否，那么使用框架只会把事情变复杂。

complicate.english: The selection service is one of the more difficult services to implement correctly because it has some valuable features that complicate the implementation.
complicate.chinese: 选择服务是比较难以正确实现的服务之一，因为它具有一些使实现复杂化的有价值的功能。

complicated.english: For young children, getting dressed is a complicated business.
complicated.chinese: 对幼童来说，穿衣服是件复杂的事。

complicated.english: The human brain is an incredibly complicated organ.
complicated.chinese: 人脑是一个结构极其复杂的器官。

complication.english: The fact that the plane was late added a further complication to our journey.
complication.chinese: 飞机误点给我们的旅行带来了更大的麻烦。

complication.english: Pneumonia is one of the common complications faced by bed-ridden patients.
complication.chinese: 肺炎是卧床病人所面临的常见并发症之一。

compliment.english: Being compared to Abba is a great compliment.
compliment.chinese: 能和阿巴乐队相提并论是极大的赞誉。

compliment.english: All the guests paid her extravagant compliments.
compliment.chinese: 所有客人都对她赞不绝口。

comply.english: The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
comply.chinese: 联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

comply.english: The commander said that the army would comply with the ceasefire.
comply.chinese: 指挥官说过部队会遵从停火协议。

component.english: Gorbachev failed to keep the component parts of the Soviet Union together.
component.chinese: 戈尔巴乔夫没能使苏联各组成部分保持在一起。

component.english: companies that make electronic components for computer products
component.chinese: 为计算机产品生产电子零件的公司

compose.english: Barrington has composed the music for a new production of ‘A Midsummer Night’s Dream’.
compose.chinese: 巴林顿为新版的《仲夏夜之梦》谱了曲。

composite.english: The child’s character was a composite of two girls I knew.
composite.chinese: 这孩子的性格综合了我认识的两个女孩的个性。

composite.english: The author builds up a useful compo-site picture of contemporary consumer culture.
composite.chinese: 作者勾勒出了一幅实用的当代消费文化全景图。

composition.english: I had to write a composition about the Royal visit.
composition.chinese: 我得写一篇关于皇室出访的作文。

composition.english: Some minerals have complex chemical compositions.
composition.chinese: 有些矿物的化学构成很复杂。

comprehend.english: She cannot comprehend the extent of the disaster.
comprehend.chinese: 她无法理解这场灾难的严重程度。

comprehend.english: I did not fully comprehend what had happened.
comprehend.chinese: 我没有完全理解发生了什么事。

comprehension.english: Why you let her talk you into doing such a foolish thing is beyond my comprehension (= impossible for me to understand ) .
comprehension.chinese: 你怎么会被她说服去做这种蠢事，我实在是无法理解。

comprehensive.english: We offer our customers a comprehensive range of financial products.
comprehensive.chinese: 我们为客户提供全面的金融产品。

comprehensive.english: The following guidelines do not aim to be totally comprehensive.
comprehensive.chinese: 以下指导原则并非想要面面俱到。

compress.english: The miners used rock drills and compressed air to drive through hard rock.
compress.chinese: 矿工使用钻岩机和压缩空气来凿穿坚硬的岩石。

compress.english: Light silk is best for parachutes, as it compresses well and then expands rapidly.
compress.chinese: 轻质丝绸最适合制作降落伞，因为这种面料便于压缩，而且展开迅速。

comprise.english: The house comprises two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a living room.
comprise.chinese: 这座房子有两间卧室、一间厨房和一间起居室。

compromise.english: If moderates fail to reach a compromise , the extremists will dominate the agenda.
compromise.chinese: 如果温和派不能达成妥协，激进派就会主宰议事日程。

compromise.english: To stop the argument they decided on a compromise.
compromise.chinese: 为停止争吵，他们决定作出妥协。

compulsory.english: He believes that the study of history should be compulsory in school.
compulsory.chinese: 他认为在学校里学习历史应该是强制性的。

compute.english: Final results had not yet been computed.
compute.chinese: 最终的结果还未计算出来。

comrade.chinese: 同志们，请支持这项动议。

conceal.english: The shadows concealed her as she crept up to the house.
conceal.chinese: 她借着阴影蹑手蹑脚地走向房子。

conceal.english: The path was concealed by long grass.
conceal.chinese: 小路隐藏在长长的草里。

concede.english: ‘That’s the only possible solution.’ ‘Yes, I suppose so,’ Charles conceded.
concede.chinese: “那是唯一可行的解决办法。”“对，我想是。”查尔斯承认道。

conceive.english: He conceived the idea of transforming the old power station into an arts centre.
conceive.chinese: 他想出了一个把旧发电站改造为艺术中心的主意。

concentrate.english: Adrian was finding it difficult to concentrate.
concentrate.chinese: 阿德里安觉得自己很难集中注意力。

concentration.english: She needed all her powers of concentration to stop herself from slipping on the icy road.
concentration.chinese: 她需要集中全部注意力才能不让自己在结冰的路上滑倒。

concentration.english: Lack of concentration was a real problem.
concentration.chinese: 注意力不集中是个大问题。

concept.english: It’s very simple, once you grasp the concept .
concept.chinese: 你一旦掌握了这个概念之后就很简单了。

concept.english: a new concept in business travel

conception.english: the original conception of the book

concern.english: His main concern is to be able to provide for his family.
concern.chinese: 他最为关心的事就是能够养家。

concern.english: He was moved by her obvious concern.
concern.chinese: 她明显的关心使他感动。

concerning.english: calls from young children concerning lost pets
concerning.chinese: 小孩子打来的有关宠物走失的电话

concerning.english: the facts concerning Marr’s car crash
concerning.chinese: 有关马尔撞车事故的事实

concert.english: Britain has to pursue policies in concert with other EU members.
concert.chinese: 英国必须和其他欧盟成员国一起贯彻各项政策。

concert.english: It appeared that both the accused were acting in concert in the attack upon the deceased.
concert.chinese: 两名被告看来是合力袭击死者的。

concession.english: He took off his jacket as a concession to the heat.
concession.chinese: 因为气温高，他只好脱掉了夹克衫。

concession.english: The British were not prepared to make any concessions .
concession.chinese: 英国人没有打算作出让步。

concise.english: Your summary should be as clear and concise as possible.
concise.chinese: 你的总结应该尽可能地明白简洁。

conclude.english: Francis, having concluded his business with James, left for Miami.
conclude.chinese: 弗朗西斯完成了和詹姆斯的买卖后就去了迈阿密。

conclude.english: When the investigation is concluded, the results will be sent to the US Attorney’s office.
conclude.chinese: 等到调查结束后，结果会被送到联邦检察官办公室。

conclusion.english: The police came to the inescapable conclusion that the children had been murdered.
conclusion.chinese: 警方得出了无法回避的结论: 这些儿童被谋杀了。

conclusion.english: All the evidence pointed to the conclusion that he was guilty.
conclusion.chinese: 所有证据都表明他是有罪的。

conclusive.english: Her attorneys claim there is no conclusive evidence that any murders took place.
conclusive.chinese: 她的律师们声称没有任何发生过谋杀的确凿证据。

concrete.english: a dialogue about concrete issues and problems
concrete.chinese: 有关具体事情和问题的对话

concrete.english: What does that mean in concrete terms ?
concrete.chinese: 具体来说那到底是什么意思？

condemn.english: Politicians were quick to condemn the bombing.
condemn.chinese: 政治家们立即对爆炸事件进行了谴责。

condense.english: the mist which condensed on every cold surface
condense.chinese: 每个冰冷的表面上凝结的水汽

condition.english: Profits increased by £1.5m, despite the difficult economic conditions.
condition.chinese: 尽管经济形势不佳，利润还是增长了150万英镑。

conduct.english: The Senator’s conduct is being investigated by the Ethics Committee.
conduct.chinese: 该参议员的行为正受到道德委员会的调查。

conduct.english: an inquiry into the conduct of the police

conductor.english: Graphite is a highly efficient conductor of electricity.
conductor.chinese: 石墨是一种高效的电导体。

conductor.english: Wood is a poor conductor of heat.

confer.english: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.
confer.chinese: 宪法还授予巴西25个成员州极大的权力。

confer.english: He conferred with Hill and the others in his office.
confer.chinese: 他和希尔以及他办公室里的其他人进行了商议。

conference.english: Representatives from over 100 countries attended the International Peace Conference in Geneva.
conference.chinese: 来自一百多个国家的代表出席了在日内瓦举行的国际和平大会。

confess.english: Occasionally people confess to crimes they haven’t committed just to get attention.
confess.chinese: 偶尔人们会承认自己并未犯过的罪行，那只是为了引人注意。

confess.english: Torture was used and Fian confessed.
confess.chinese: 酷刑用过之后菲安就招供了。

confidence.english: I felt I was doing well and my confidence began to grow.
confidence.chinese: 我觉得自己干得不错，自信心就开始增加了。

confidence.english: I have never betrayed a confidence.
confidence.chinese: 我从未泄露过别人的秘密。

confident.english: Despite her disability, Philippa is very confident.
confident.chinese: 菲莉帕虽然有残疾，却很自信。

confidential.english: Doctors are required to keep patients’ records completely confidential .
confidential.chinese: 医生必须对病人的病历完全保密。

confidential.english: The information will be regarded as strictly confidential (= completely confidential ) .
confidential.chinese: 这一信息将被视为绝对机密。

confine.english: Vaughan is confined to a wheelchair .

confirm.english: To confirm my diagnosis I need to do some tests.
confirm.chinese: 为了证实我的诊断，我要做一些化验。

confirm.english: New evidence has confirmed the first witness’s story.
confirm.chinese: 新的证据证实了第一个证人的说法。

confirmation.english: There has still been no official confirmation of the report.
confirmation.chinese: 这则报道仍未得到官方证实。

conflict.english: Doctors exercise considerable power and often come into conflict with politicians.
conflict.chinese: 医生行使很大的权力，常常和政客们发生冲突。

conflict.english: Personal ethics and professional ethics sometimes conflict.
conflict.chinese: 个人道德与职业道德之间有时会相冲突。

conform.english: It did not conform to the usual stereotype of an industrial city.
conform.chinese: 这和一座常规的工业城市那种千篇一律的格局不一样。

conform.english: The building does not conform with safety regulations.
conform.chinese: 例句：这座建筑物不符合安全条例。

conformity.english: We must act in conformity with local regulations.
conformity.chinese: 我们必须按当地的法规行事。

confront.english: I confronted him with my suspicions, and he admitted everything.
confront.chinese: 我当面向他提出我的怀疑，他什么都承认了。

confront.english: The problems confronting the new government were enormous.
confront.chinese: 新政府面临的难题是巨大的。

confrontation.english: She had stayed in her room to avoid another confrontation.
confrontation.chinese: 她待在自己的房间里，以避免再次发生冲突。

confrontational.english: The committee's confrontational style of campaigning has made it unpopular.
confrontational.chinese: 该委员会挑衅的宣传方式使之不得人心。

confuse.english: People might well confuse the two products.
confuse.chinese: 人们很容易混淆这两种产品。

confuse.english: I understand the text but the diagrams are confusing me.
confuse.chinese: 文字我理解，但是图表把我弄糊涂了。

confusion.english: To avoid confusion, the teams wore different colours.
confusion.chinese: 为了避免混淆，各队穿着不同颜色的服装。

congratulate.english: He never even stopped to congratulate me.
congratulate.chinese: 他甚至没有过来向我祝贺。

congress.english: a congress of the ruling Labor Party
congress.chinese: 执政党工党的代表大会

conjunction.english: The worksheets are designed to be used in conjunction with the new course books.
conjunction.chinese: 这些活页练习题专门用来与新课本配套使用。

connect.english: We’d like two rooms with connecting doors (= doors that join the rooms ) .
connect.chinese: 我们想要两个有门相通的房间。

connection.english: Police have so far failed to establish a connection between the two murders.
connection.chinese: 到目前为止警方尚未确定两宗凶杀案之间有关联。

connection.english: He demonstrated the close connection between social conditions and health.
connection.chinese: 他证明了社会条件和健康之间的密切联系。

connectivity.english: a growing demand for high-speed connectivity
connectivity.chinese: 对高速连接功能日益增长的需求

conquer.english: Egypt was conquered by the Persian king Kambyses.
conquer.chinese: 埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。
诺曼人于 1066 年征服英格兰。

conqueror.english: The people of an oppressed country obey their conquerors because they want to go on living.
conqueror.chinese: 一个被压迫国家的人民顺从他们的征服者，是因为他们想活下去。

corrupt.chinese: 年轻的囚犯正在被年纪较大、刑期长的犯人带坏。

corruption.english: The investigation uncovered widespread corruption within the police force.
corruption.chinese: 这项调查揭发出了警察机关内部普遍的腐败。

corruption.english: officials charged with bribery and corruption
corruption.chinese: 被指控受贿和贪污的官员

cosmic.english: the cosmic laws governing our world
cosmic.chinese: 主宰我们世界的宇宙法则

cost.english: This doesn’t include the cost of repairing the damage.
cost.chinese: 这不包括修理破损的费用。

cost.english: Insurance to cover the cost of a funeral is possible.
cost.chinese: 可以用保险支付葬礼费用。

costly.english: Such a database would be extremely costly to set up.
costly.chinese: 建立这样一个数据库要花很多钱。

costume.english: the film’s lavish costumes and spectacular sets
costume.chinese: 影片中奢华的戏装和壮观的场景

cottage.english: We’re staying in a holiday cottage in Dorset.
cottage.chinese: 我们住在多塞特的一个度假小别墅里。

couch.english: Tom offered to sleep on the couch.

cough.english: I think I’m getting a cold or flu – I’ve been coughing and sneezing all day.
cough.chinese: 我想我是着凉了，或者得了流感——我整天都在咳嗽和打喷嚏。

cough.english: Matthew coughed and cleared his throat.
cough.chinese: 马修咳了一声清清喉咙。

counsel.english: He had always been able to count on her wise counsel.
counsel.chinese: 他总是能够指望她明智的忠告。

counsel.english: The judge asked counsel for the defence to explain.
counsel.chinese: 法官要求被告的辩护律师作出解释。

counseling.english: If the answer is no, you really need to get some professional counseling to determine if this marriage should be saved.
counseling.chinese: 如果回答是否定的，你就真的该去咨询一下专家，决定一下你是否改维持这段婚姻了。

counseling.english: Despite counseling and written advice about how to maintain their new weights, they gained an average of 12 pounds back over the next year.
counseling.chinese: 尽管有如何保持研究者各自重获得的新体重方面的咨询与书面建议，但在过去一年里平均每人仍增重12磅左右。

count.english: I was amazed at the number of plants - I counted 147.
count.chinese: 我对植物的数量之多感到惊讶，我数了有147棵。

count.english: Davis was found not guilty on all counts .
count.chinese: 戴维斯受到指控的各项罪名均不成立。

counter.english: Some actions by the authorities ran counter to the President’s call for leniency.
counter.chinese: 当局的某些行为和总统呼吁的宽容背道而驰。

counter.english: He wondered if the girl behind the counter recognised him.
counter.chinese: 他在想柜台后面的那个女孩是否认出了他。

counterpart.english: As soon as he heard what was afoot, he telephoned his German and Italian counterparts to protest.
counterpart.chinese: 他一听到在进行中的事，马上就给德国和意大利相应人员打电话抗议。

countryside.english: The house had lovely views over open countryside .
countryside.chinese: 这房子望出去是开阔的乡村美景。

coupon.english: The coupon entitles you to ten cents off your next purchase.
coupon.chinese: 这张优惠券可以让你在下次购物时节省10分钱。

courage.english: Sue showed great courage throughout her illness.
courage.chinese: 休在生病期间表现出了极大的勇气。

courage.english: Driving again after his accident must have taken a lot of courage (= needed courage ) .
courage.chinese: 他出事故后再驾车肯定需要很大的勇气。

courageous.english: He was wrong, and courageous enough to admit it.
courageous.chinese: 他是错了，而且有勇气承认自己错了。

court.english: Four people will appear in court today, charged with fraud.
court.chinese: 今天将有四个人因被指控犯有欺诈罪出庭受审。

court.english: The court ruled that no compensation was due.

courteous.english: The staff are always courteous and helpful.
courteous.chinese: 员工们总是彬彬有礼、乐于帮助。

courtesy.english: It’s a matter of common courtesy to acknowledge letters.
courtesy.chinese: 确认收到来信是起码的礼貌。

cousin.english: My cousin Mark helped me to bring in the bags.
cousin.chinese: 我表弟马克帮我把包提了进来。

cover.english: Cover the pot and bake for an hour.
She wore a low-cut dress, partly covered by a thin shawl.
cover.chinese: 她穿了件低胸连衣裙，搭了一条薄薄的披肩。

coverage.english: live coverage of the match (= the match is broadcast at the same time that it is happening )

coward.english: Try it. Don’t be such a coward.

cozy.english: “It is extremely expensive, but at least I have a cozy bed, ” he said.
cozy.chinese: 他说：“这房子真是太贵了，但至少我有一张舒适的床了。”

cozy.english: Come over to the fire and cozy up a bit.
cozy.chinese: 到火炉这边来会感到舒适一点。

crack.english: She opened the door a crack and peeped into the room.
crack.chinese: 她把门打开一条缝，往房间里偷看。

crack.english: Dennis rubbed his hands together and cracked his knuckles .
crack.chinese: 丹尼斯搓着双手，把指关节弄得咯咯响。

cradle.english: Athens is often regarded as the cradle of democracy.
cradle.chinese: 雅典常常被认为是民主的发源地。

cradle.english: She rocked the cradle to quieten the child.
cradle.chinese: 她摇动摇篮，让宝宝安静下来。

craft.english: The musician spends years perfecting his craft.
craft.chinese: 这位音乐家多年来不断提高自己的艺术造诣。

crane.english: The little prefabricated hut was lifted away by a huge crane.
crane.chinese: 那间小小的预制棚屋被一台巨大的起重机吊走了。

crank.english: He was idly turning a crank on a strange mechanism strapped to his chest.
crank.chinese: 他漫不经心地转着绑在他胸前的一个古怪装置上面的曲柄。

crash.english: The door swung inwards to crash against a chest of drawers behind it.
crash.chinese: 门摆向里面，砰的一声猛力撞上了门后的五斗橱。

crash.english: My words were lost as the walls above us crashed down, filling the cellar with brick dust.
crash.chinese: 随着上面的墙体轰隆一声倒塌下来，地窖里充满砖灰，我吓得说不出话来。

crawl.english: The floor was crawling with ants.
We crawled into bed at 2 am.
crawl.chinese: 我们凌晨两点爬上了床。

crazy.english: I know this idea sounds crazy , but it may be worth a try.
crazy.chinese: 我知道这个主意听起来很荒唐，但也许值得一试。

crazy.english: He often works 12 hours a day – it’s crazy .
crazy.chinese: 他常常一天工作12个小时——简直疯了。

create.english: The new factory is expected to create more than 400 new jobs.
create.chinese: 这家新工厂预计能创造400多个新的就业机会。

create.english: Some people believe the universe was created by a big explosion.
create.chinese: 有些人认为宇宙是通过一次大爆炸创造出来的。

creative.english: This job is so boring. I wish I could do something more creative.
creative.chinese: 这工作太单调了，我希望能做些更有创造性的事情。

creative.english: Diaghilev did his great creative work in France.
creative.chinese: 狄亚格列夫在法国编创了富有创新性的伟大作品。

creativity.english: Editors complain about the lack of creativity in the ideas put to them.
creativity.chinese: 编辑们抱怨说交给他们的选题缺乏创意。

creativity.english: Teachers have been attacked for stifling creativity in their pupils.
creativity.chinese: 教师被批评压抑了学生的创造力。

creature.english: all the living creatures in the sea

credible.english: a credible alternative to nuclear power

credible.chinese: 她的借口无法让人信服。

credit.english: The witness’s story gained credit with the jury.
credit.chinese: 证人的陈述被陪审团采信了。

credit.english: What’s the credit limit on your Visa card?
credit.chinese: 你的维萨卡信用额度是多少？

creep.english: He crept back up the stairs, trying to avoid the ones that creaked.
creep.chinese: 他蹑手蹑脚地回楼上，尽量避开那些嘎吱作响的梯级。

crew.english: The plane crashed, killing two of the crew and four passengers.
crew.chinese: 飞机坠毁，造成两名机组人员和四名乘客死亡。

cricket.english: He was pressganged into playing in the charity cricket match.
cricket.chinese: 他是被强拉去参加这场板球义赛的。

cricket.english: He angrily stomped his cricket after failing the fight.
cricket.chinese: 比赛失败后，他生气地踏死了他的蟋蟀。

crime.english: Police officers are being given new powers to help combat crime.
crime.chinese: 警官们被赋予新的权力帮助他们打击犯罪。

crime.english: We moved here because there was very little crime.
crime.chinese: 我们搬到这里来是因为这里的犯罪率很低。

criminal.english: Police have described the man as a violent and dangerous criminal.
criminal.chinese: 警方形容那名男子是个凶暴而危险的罪犯。

criminal.english: I was sure he was involved in some kind of criminal activity .
criminal.chinese: 我肯定他在从事某种犯罪活动。

criminology.english: The relationship between victimology and criminology is a longstanding issue within the academic realm.
criminology.chinese: 被害人学与犯罪学之间的关系问题是学界的一个宿疑。

criminology.english: While beefed up network security is crucial criminology professor David Maimon, of the University of Maryland, says that's only half the solution.
criminology.chinese: 在加强网络安全至关重要时，马里兰大学的犯罪学教授大卫·麦农表示那只是一半的解决方案。

cripple.english: She has gone from being a healthy, fit, and sporty young woman to being a cripple.
cripple.chinese: 她从一个健康、强壮、爱好体育运动的年轻姑娘变成了一个残疾人。

crisis.english: The Prime Minister was criticized for the way in which he handled the crisis .
crisis.chinese: 首相处理危机的方式遭到了批评。

crisis.english: I was relieved that we had averted yet another financial crisis .
crisis.chinese: 我如释重负，我们又避免了一场财政危机。

crisp.english: He stepped carefully through the crisp deep snow.
crisp.chinese: 他小心地走在松脆的、厚厚的雪地里。

crisp.english: Cook the pastry until it is crisp and golden.
crisp.chinese: 把油酥面团烤到发脆并呈金黄色。

criteria.english: The most important criterion for entry is that applicants must design and make their own work.
criteria.chinese: 参加的最重要标准就是申请人必须设计并制作自己的作品。

criterion.english: the criteria we use to select candidates
criterion.chinese: 我们挑选候选人的标准

critic.english: Mather was a film critic for many years.
critic.chinese: 马瑟做过多年的电影评论家。

critical.english: He made some highly critical remarks.
critical.chinese: 他发表了一些严厉的批判性言论。

criticism.english: The government’s economic strategy has attracted a lot of criticism .
criticism.chinese: 政府的经济政策招致了大量的批评。

criticism.english: Another criticism levelled at him was that his teaching methods were old-fashioned.
criticism.chinese: 还有一个针对他的批评是，他的教学方法已经过时。

criticize.english: Ron does nothing but criticize and complain all the time.
criticize.chinese: 罗恩什么也不干，只是一味指责和抱怨。

criticize.english: The new law has been widely criticized .
criticize.chinese: 这项新法律受到了广泛的批评。

crop.english: The main crops were oats and barley.
crop.chinese: 主要作物是燕麦和大麦。

cropland.english: But it is "crucial" that farmers are not encouraged to use productive cropland to grow biofuel crops, it says.
cropland.chinese: 但是该报告说，关键在于不要鼓励农民使用富饶的农田种植生物燃料作物。

cropland.english: Fly ash uranium sometimes leaches into the soil and water surrounding a coal plant, affecting cropland and, in turn, food.
cropland.chinese: 浮尘中含有的铀有时会溶入煤电厂周围的土壤和水体中，影响农田，进而影响食物。

cross.english: She gets cross when he goes out drinking.
cross.chinese: 他出去喝酒她就不高兴。

cross.english: She was cross at being interrupted.
cross.chinese: 被人打断了话，她很生气。

crossing.english: You must give way to any pedestrians on the crossing.
crossing.chinese: 必须让人行横道上的行人先行。

crow.english: The crows roosted in Fonsa's Tower.
crow.chinese: 那些乌鸦栖息在风萨塔里。

crowd.english: Troops fired tear gas and shots to disperse a crowd of 15,000 demonstrators.
crowd.chinese: 军队发射催泪弹并开枪来驱散15,000名示威群众。

crowd.english: She mingled with the crowd of guests, exchanging greetings.
crowd.chinese: 她穿梭在宾客中间和他们打招呼。

crown.english: How long does it take to have crowns fitted?

crucial.english: The conservation of tropical forests is of crucial importance .
crucial.chinese: 保护热带雨林至关重要。

crude.english: a crude estimate of the population available for work
crude.chinese: 对劳动力人口的粗略估计

cruel.chinese: 有时候生活残酷得让人无法承受。

cruel.english: His death was a cruel blow .
cruel.chinese: 他的死是个无情的打击。

cruelty.english: The children had suffered cruelty and neglect.
cruelty.chinese: 这些孩子遭受虐待，无人照管。

cruelty.english: There was a hint of cruelty in Brian’s smile.
cruelty.chinese: 布赖恩的微笑里流露出一丝残暴。

cruise.english: He and his wife were planning to go on a world cruise.
cruise.chinese: 他和妻子那时正计划进行一次环球海上航游。

cruise.english: She wants to cruise the canals of France in a barge.
cruise.chinese: 她想坐驳船游览法国的运河。

crumble.english: The Empire began to crumble during the 13th century.
crumble.chinese: 这个帝国在13世纪时开始崩溃。

crush.english: Two people were crushed to death in the rush to escape.
crush.chinese: 两个人在逃生过程中被踩死。

crush.english: His leg was crushed in the accident.
crush.chinese: 他的腿在事故中被压断。

crust.english: sandwiches with the crusts cut off

cry.english: That film always makes me cry .
cry.chinese: 那部影片总是让我落泪。

cry.english: Don’t cry, Laura. It’ll be OK.

crystal.english: a set of six crystal glasses

crystallize.english: The liquid will crystallize at 50 degrees centigrade.
crystallize.chinese: 这种液体在50摄氏度时结晶。

cube.english: Cut the meat into small cubes.

cubic.english: the cubic capacity of an engine

cuckoo.english: In England the cuckoo is the herald of spring.
cuckoo.chinese: 在英国杜鹃鸟是报春的使者。

cucumber.english: The "gurkophone" is one of their classics, made from a hollowed cucumber, a pepper and a carrot.
cucumber.chinese: 黄瓜管"是他们的经典乐器之一,那是用掏空的黄瓜、辣椒和胡萝卜做的。

cucumber.english: The "gurkophone" is one of their classics, made from a hollowed cucumber , a pepper and a carrot.
cucumber.chinese: 黄瓜管“是他们的经典乐器之一，那是用掏空的黄瓜、辣椒和胡萝卜做的。

cue.english: She stood nervously in the wings waiting for her cue.
cue.chinese: 她紧张地站在台侧等待出场的提示。

culminate.english: They had an argument, which culminated in Tom getting drunk.
culminate.chinese: 他们发生了争论，结果导致汤姆喝醉了酒。

cultivate.english: The land was too rocky to cultivate.
cultivate.chinese: 这块地石头太多，无法耕作。

culture.english: In our culture, it is rude to ask someone how much they earn.
culture.chinese: 在我们的文化里，问别人收入多少是不礼貌的。

culture.english: We speak Danish at home so that the boys don’t lose touch with their language and culture.
culture.chinese: 我们在家说丹麦语，这样男孩子们就不会脱离他们的语言和文化。

cumulative.chinese: 学习是个逐渐积累的过程。

cup.english: Mathew picked up the cup and sipped his coffee.
cup.chinese: 马修拿起杯子抿了口咖啡。

cup.english: She put her cup and saucer down on the table.

curb.english: measures to curb the spread of the virus

cure.english: She had some acupuncture treatment which seems to have cured her.
cure.chinese: 她接受了某种针刺疗法，好像把她的病治好了。

curiosity.english: The news aroused a lot of curiosity among local people.
curiosity.chinese: 这条消息在当地人中间引起了很大的好奇心。

curiosity.english: I opened the packet just to satisfy my curiosity .
curiosity.chinese: 我打开包裹只是为了满足我的好奇心。

curl.english: Use a diffuser to maximise the volume and curl of your hair.
curl.chinese: 使用电吹风罩把头发吹得蓬松卷曲。

curl.english: hair that has a natural curl

currency.english: There are moves towards a single currency in Europe.
currency.chinese: 欧洲有向单一货币发展的趋势。

currency.english: The bank can supply you with foreign currency .
currency.chinese: 这家银行能为你提供外币。

current.english: In its current state, the car is worth £1,000.
current.chinese: 这辆车按现在的车况来看值1,000英镑。

currently.english: He is currently working on his first novel.
currently.chinese: 他目前正在创作他的第一本小说。

currently.english: the products that are currently available

curriculum.english: Languages are an essential part of the school curriculum.
curriculum.chinese: 语言是学校课程中必不可少的部分。

curse.english: He believed that someone had put a curse on the house.
curse.chinese: 他相信有人对这房子下了诅咒。

curse.english: Gilbert was cursing under his breath.

curve.english: The curve illustrates costs per capita.
curve.chinese: 这条曲线显示人均费用。

curve.english: The track curved round the side of the hill.
curve.chinese: 小路弯弯曲曲，依山盘旋。

custom.english: He awoke early, as was his custom.
custom.chinese: 他很早醒来，这是他的习惯。

custom.english: You won’t be able to take that through customs.
custom.chinese: 你带着那东西过不了海关的。

customary.english: In some cultures it is customary for the bride to wear white.
customary.chinese: 在一些文化中，新娘按风俗要穿白色。

customary.english: Barbara answered with her customary enthusiasm.
customary.chinese: 芭芭拉以惯有的热情作了回答。

customer.english: We aim to offer good value and service to all our customers.
customer.chinese: 我们力求为所有的客户提供物有所值的商品和服务。

customer.english: We’ve had several letters from satisfied customers.
customer.chinese: 我们收到了几封顾客表示满意的来信。

cut.english: Seven hundred jobs will be lost in order to cut costs and boost profits.
cut.chinese: 为了降低成本，提高利润，将削减700个职位。

cut.english: They’re introducing CCTV cameras in an attempt to cut street crime in the area.
cut.chinese: 为了减少该地区的街头犯罪，他们安装了闭路电视摄像机。

cylinder.english: The gases are stored in cylinders.

cynical.english: a cynical view of human nature
cynical.chinese: 认为人性本恶的一种观点

dairy.english: He avoids all meat and dairy products.
dairy.chinese: 他不吃任何肉类和奶制品。

dairy.english: In my childhood, local dairies bought milk from local farmers.
dairy.chinese: 在我小时候，本地的乳品公司向当地农场主收购牛奶。

dam.english: Before the dam was built, Campbell River used to flood in the spring.
dam.chinese: 大坝建好之前，坎贝尔河常在春季发大水。

damn.english: Damn! I’ve left my keys in the office.
damn.chinese: 见鬼！我把钥匙忘在办公室了。

damp.english: Wipe the leather with a damp cloth.

dampen.english: Raising interest rates might dampen the economy.
dampen.chinese: 提高利率可能会抑制经济发展。

dampen.english: The light rain dampened the crowd’s enthusiasm.
dampen.chinese: 小雨使观众的热情减退了。

danger.english: The refugees believe that their lives are in danger .
danger.chinese: 难民认为他们有生命危险。

danger.english: Danger! No boats beyond this point.
danger.chinese: 危险！船只不可越过此处。

dangerous.english: Some of these prisoners are extremely dangerous.
dangerous.chinese: 这些囚犯中有些极为危险。

dangerous.english: The powdered milk was not as good as breast milk, and was downright dangerous (= actually dangerous ) when it was mixed with unclean water.
dangerous.chinese: 奶粉没有母乳好，用不洁净的水冲调更会造成危险。

dare.english: He wanted to ask her, but he didn’t dare.

dark.english: The church was dark and quiet.
dark.chinese: 教堂里黑魆魆的，寂静无声。

dark.english: It was still dark (= was night ) when we boarded the train.
dark.chinese: 我们上火车时天还是黑的。

dart.english: Jill darted forward and pulled him away from the fire.
dart.chinese: 吉尔冲上前把他从火边拉开。

dart.english: She darted a sly sideways glance at Bramwell.

endurance.english: She was pushed beyond her powers of endurance.
The marathon is a test of endurance.
endurance.chinese: 马拉松赛跑是对耐力的考验。

endure.english: It seemed impossible that anyone could endure such pain.
endure.chinese: 似乎谁都不可能忍受这样的疼痛。

enemy.english: the unforgettable sight of the president shaking hands with his sworn enemy
enemy.chinese: 董事长与其死敌握手的难忘情景

enemy.english: I wouldn’t wishthis on my worst enemy.
enemy.chinese: 即使是我的死对头，我也不愿看到他发生这样的事情。

energetic.english: an energetic drive to get more customers
energetic.chinese: 争取更多客户的十足干劲

energy.english: The problem with nuclear energy is dealing with the waste.
energy.chinese: 核能的问题就是要处理核废料。

energy.english: The water is heated using energy from the sun.
energy.chinese: 水是利用太阳能加热的。

enforce.english: Parking restrictions will be strictly enforced.
enforce.chinese: 停车限制将会严格执行。

engage.english: The wheel engages with the cog and turns it.
engage.chinese: 轮子咬住轮齿并带动它转动。

engage.english: I have never engaged in drug trafficking.
engage.chinese: 我从来没有从事过贩毒。

engagement.english: This is his only public speaking engagement on the tour.
engagement.chinese: 这是他此行唯一一场公开演讲。

engagement.english: Their engagement was announced in the paper.
engagement.chinese: 他们订婚的消息在报上公布了。

engine.english: We were stranded with engine trouble on a deserted highway.
engine.chinese: 我们因发动机故障而被困在空无一人的公路上。

engineer.english: He trained as a civil engineer (= one who designs and builds roads, bridges etc ).
engineer.chinese: 他接受过土木工程师培训。

engineering.english: Their inventions have contributed to the development of electrical engineering.
engineering.chinese: 他们的发明有助于电气工程学的发展。

englishman.english: He was the only Englishman present.
englishman.chinese: 他是在场的唯一一名英国人。

englishman.english: Report writing, like motor car driving and lovemaking, is one of those activities that every Englishman thinks he can do well without instruction.
englishman.chinese: 写报告，像开车和做爱一样，是每个英国人都以为自己毋需指导就能做好的事。

enhance.english: Good lighting will enhance any room.
enhance.chinese: 良好的照明能给房间增色不少。

enhance.english: The publicity has enhanced his reputation.
enhance.chinese: 这次宣传提高了他的声誉。

enjoy.english: Sandra enjoys her job in the city.
enjoy.chinese: 桑德拉很喜欢她在城里的这份工作。

enjoy.english: I enjoyed every minute of it.

enlarge.english: an operation to enlarge her breasts
Police will have the pictures enlarged in an attempt to identify the thief.
enlarge.chinese: 为了确认窃贼的身份，警方会将这些照片放大。

enlighten.english: A few dedicated doctors have fought for years to enlighten the profession.
enlighten.chinese: 少数富有献身精神的医生为启蒙这一行业而奋斗多年。

enlighten.english: Baldwin enlightened her as to the nature of the experiment.
enlighten.chinese: 鲍德温给她讲解了这个实验的性质。

enlightenment.english: Isabel looked to Ron for enlightenment.
enlightenment.chinese: 伊莎贝尔希望得到罗恩的启发。

enormous.english: The team made an enormous effort.
enormous.chinese: 该队付出了巨大的努力。

enough.english: Her disappearance and death would give proof enough of Charles' guilt.
enough.chinese: 她的失踪和死亡将提供足够的证据证明查尔斯有罪。

enquire.english: Day and day I take pains to enquire myself my reason for doing so, in no time will I stoop so low as to beg you sympathy, though I can feel your scoff all the time.
enquire.chinese: 日复一日，我不厌其详地询问我自己，我在任何时候都这样低俯恳求你同情，但我能感受到你对这一切一切嗤之以鼻。

enquire.english: We have obtained your company information from china. alibaba. com. So we are Emailing you to enquire whether you would be willing to establish new business relations with us.
enquire.chinese: 我们从阿里巴巴网站上得到贵公司资讯。我们传送此封邮件给您是想询问您是否愿意与我们建立新的业务关系。

enquiry.english: When fresh supplies come into the market, we can revert to your enquiry.
enquiry.chinese: 等新货上市时，我们才能回头考虑你们的询盘。

enquiry.english: She has taken my enquiry as a personal affront.
enquiry.chinese: 她将我的询问当成了人身侮辱。

enrich.english: Education can greatly enrich your life.
enrich.chinese: 教育可以大大充实生活。

enrich.english: Add fertilizer to enrich the soil.

enroll.english: You need to enroll before the end of August.
enroll.chinese: 你必须在八月底前注册。

enroll.english: And, with the rise of online education, you can even enroll in certified programs that allow you to learn and improve your career during your off-hours.
enroll.chinese: 并且，随着在线教育的崛起，你甚至可以参加认证课程，在下班工夫里学习和改善本人的职业生涯。

enrollment.english: Class enrollment, where each student has all of the course schedule selections, each student having his own bucket in the CGTT.
enrollment.chinese: 班级入学，每个学生都有所有的课程安排选择，每个学生都将自己的选择放在 CGTT 中。

ensue.english: If the Europeans did not reduce subsidies, a trade war would ensue.
ensue.chinese: 如果欧洲不减少补贴，贸易战将随即爆发。

ensure.english: facilities to ensure the safety of cyclists
ensure.chinese: 确保骑车人安全的设施

entail.english: A new computer system entails a lot of re-training.
entail.chinese: 使用新的计算机系统需要大量的再培训。

entail.english: Some foreign travel is entailed in the job.
entail.chinese: 做这份工作有时要到国外出差。

enter.english: The rebels were prepared to enter negotiations (= start discussing something ).
enter.chinese: 叛乱分子愿意参加谈判。

enter.english: He entered the election as the clear favourite.
enter.chinese: 他参加竞选时显然最有希望获胜。

enterprise.english: The programme is a joint enterprise with the London Business School.
enterprise.chinese: 这一计划是与伦敦商学院的合作项目。

enterprise.english: We’re looking for young people with enterprise and creativity.
enterprise.chinese: 例句：我们在寻找有事业心和创造力的年轻人。

entertain.english: Mark usually does the cooking when we entertain.
entertain.chinese: 我们招待客人时通常都是马克下厨。

entertain.english: Do you get an allowance for entertaining clients?

entertaining.english: Children’s TV nowadays is much more entertaining.
entertaining.chinese: 如今的儿童电视节目要比过去有趣多了。

entertainment.english: The town provides a wide choice of entertainment.
entertainment.chinese: 该镇提供各式各样的娱乐活动。

entertainment.english: The dolphins give good entertainment value (= a lot of amusement and interest ).
entertainment.chinese: 海豚具有很高的娱乐价值。

enthusiasm.english: Gillian and Darren greeted the speakers with great enthusiasm.
enthusiasm.chinese: 吉利恩和达伦非常热情地接待了演讲者。

enthusiasm.english: We went along to the local diving club, full of enthusiasm.
enthusiasm.chinese: 我们兴高采烈地去了当地的潜水俱乐部。

entire.english: It was the worst day in my entire life.
entire.chinese: 那是我一生中最糟糕的一天。

entire.english: Have you drunk the entire bottle?

entitle.english: If the warranty is limited, the terms may entitle you to a replacement or refund.
entitle.chinese: 如果保修单有限制，这些条款可让你有权换货或退款。

entitle.english: They understood that our power alone cannot protect us, nor does it entitle us to do as we please.
entitle.chinese: 他们懂得单凭实力无法保护我们的安全，实力也并不赋予我们随心所欲的权利。

entity.english: Good design brings a house and garden together as a single entity.
entity.chinese: 优秀的设计能把一所房子和花园合为一体。

entity.english: The mind exists as a separate entity.
entity.chinese: 思想作为一个独立的实体存在。

entreat.english: He entreated them to delay their departure.
His friends entreated him not to go.
entreat.chinese: 他的朋友们恳求他不要去。

entrepreneur.english: “You have to be an optimist to be an inventor or entrepreneur, ” he concludes.
entrepreneur.chinese: 要成为一位发明家或企业家，你必须得是个乐天派。

entrepreneur.english: "You have to be an optimist to be an inventor or entrepreneur, " he concludes.
entrepreneur.chinese: 要成为一位发明家或企业家，你必须得是个乐天派。

entrepreneurship.english: They, like other necessity entrepreneurs, may have resorted to entrepreneurship due to a lack of better options.
entrepreneurship.chinese: 他们像其他生存型企业家一样，因为没有更好的选择才会诉诸于创业。

entry.english: You can leave your umbrella in the entry.
entry.chinese: 你可以把伞放在入口处。

entry.english: There was no sign of a forced entry.

envelope.english: She tore open the envelope and frantically read the letter.
He got a job stuffing envelopes (= filling them with letters ) at the campaign headquarters.
envelope.chinese: 他找了一份在竞选总部装信封的工作。

enviable.english: Now he was in the enviable position of not having to work for a living.
enviable.chinese: 现在他已不必为生计而工作，着实令人羡慕。

environment.english: Some of these chemicals are very damaging to the environment.
environment.chinese: 这些化学品中有些对环境非常有害。

environment.english: the effects of acid rain on the environment

environmental.english: the environmental damage caused by the chemical industry
environmental.chinese: 化学工业对环境造成的破坏

environmental.english: an international meeting to discuss environmental issues
environmental.chinese: 探讨环境问题的国际会议

envisage.english: The scheme cost a lot more than we had originally envisaged.
envisage.chinese: 该计划的花费大大超出了我们最初所预想的数额。

envy.english: I really envy you and Ian, you seem so happy together.
envy.chinese: 我真是羡慕你和伊恩，你俩在一起看起来多幸福。

envy.english: She has a lifestyle which most people would envy.
envy.chinese: 她的生活方式会令大多数人感到羡慕。

epidemic.english: Over 500 people died during last year’s flu epidemic.
epidemic.chinese: 去年流感大暴发期间有五百多人死亡。

episode.english: I'd like to try and forget the whole episode.
episode.chinese: 我倒想尽量把那段经历全部忘掉。
请收看下周精彩的一集！

epoch.english: The king’s death marked the end of an epoch.
epoch.chinese: 这位国王的去世标志着一个时代的结束。

epoch.english: the beginning of a new epoch

equal.english: Our constitution states that all men are equal.
equal.chinese: 我们的宪法规定人人平等。

equation.english: When children enter the equation , further tensions may arise within a marriage.
equation.chinese: 有了孩子以后，婚姻中可能出现新的矛盾。

equation.english: In the equation 2x + 1 = 7, what is x?
equation.chinese: 在方程式2x+1=7中，x的值为多少？

equator.english: Knows(Those ) from south of the [ equator ] come to the United States during the northern winter .
equator.chinese: 那些来自赤道以南的学生在北方的冬天来到美国。

equator.english: a small village near the equator

equilibrium.english: The government is anxious not to upset the economic equilibrium.
equilibrium.chinese: 政府急切希望不要打乱经济平衡。

equip.english: They try to equip their vehicles with gadgets to deal with every possible contingency.
equip.chinese: 他们尽量给他们的车辆配备各种小装置以应付任何可能的突发状况。

equipment.english: a very useful piece of equipment

equivalent.english: I had no dollars, but offered him an equivalent amount of sterling.
equivalent.chinese: 我没有美金，但给了他等值的英镑。

era.english: His death marked the end of an era.
era.chinese: 他的去世标志着一个时代的终结。

eradicate.english: This problem has now been completely eradicated.
eradicate.chinese: 这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

erect.english: Martin stood erect on the platform.
erect.chinese: 马丁在讲台上笔直地站着。

erect.english: Police have erected barriers across the main roads into the town.
erect.chinese: 警察在进城的主要道路上设立了路障。

errand.english: He quickly set out on his errand of mercy (= journey to help someone in danger ).
errand.chinese: 他迅速启程参加救援行动。

errand.english: I seemed to spend my life running errands for people.
errand.chinese: 我好像一辈子都在为别人跑腿。

erroneous.english: His economic predictions are based on some erroneous assumptions.
erroneous.chinese: 他的经济预测是基于错误假设之上的。

erupt.english: Violence erupted after police shot a student during the demonstration.
erupt.chinese: 警察向示威人群中的一名学生开枪，暴乱随之发生。

erupt.english: A political row erupted over the MP’s comments.
erupt.chinese: 这名下院议员的评论引发了一场政治论战。

escape.english: Vents allow any steam to escape if the system overheats.
escape.chinese: 如果系统过热，排放口可使蒸汽逸出。

escort.english: The shipment was escorted by guards.
escort.chinese: 货物的运输由卫兵护送。

especially.english: Art books are expensive to produce, especially if they contain colour illustrations.
especially.chinese: 美术类书籍制作成本很高，尤其是那些带彩色插图的。

especially.english: I never liked long walks, especially in winter.
especially.chinese: 我向来不喜欢长距离散步，尤其在冬天。

essay.english: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown.
essay.chinese: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

essence.english: In essence his message was very simple.
essence.chinese: 实质上他想表达的意思很简单。

essential.english: Even in small companies, computers are an essential tool.
essential.chinese: 即使在小公司里，计算机也是不可或缺的工具。

essential.english: Window locks are fairly cheap and absolutely essential.
essential.chinese: 窗锁相当便宜，绝对有必要安装。

essentially.english: Essentially, we are talking about the cold war period.
essentially.chinese: 我们基本上是在谈论冷战时期。

essentially.english: Suicide rates have remained essentially unchanged.
essentially.chinese: 自杀率基本上保持不变。

establish.english: He’d already begun to establish quite a reputation as a journalist.
establish.chinese: 身为记者，他已经声名鹊起。

establish.english: He had three years in which to establish himself as Prime Minister.
establish.chinese: 他有三年时间来确立自己首相的地位。

establishment.english: The establishment of the regional government in 1980 did not end terrorism.
establishment.chinese: 1980年地区政府的成立并没有结束恐怖主义。

estate.english: The property is part of the deceased’s estate.
estate.chinese: 该产业是死者遗产的一部分。
他的遗产价值为15万美元。

esteem.english: This is why I esteem the individual only because he strikes me as ridiculous and humiliated.
esteem.chinese: 这是我为什么尊重个体，就是因为他让我深深地感到荒诞和屈辱。

esteem.english: After that, we could go for esteem and respect.
esteem.chinese: 而再往上，我们可能需要自尊和尊重。

estimate.english: Try to estimate how many steps it will take to get to a close object.
estimate.chinese: 估计一下需要多少步才能到达一个近距目标。

eternal.english: the Christian promise of eternal life
She’s an eternal optimist (= she always expects that good things will happen ).
eternal.chinese: 她永远是个乐观主义者。

ethnic.english: The school teaches pupils from different ethnic groups.
ethnic.chinese: 该校教授不同种族的小学生。

ethnic.english: plans to partition the republic along ethnic lines
ethnic.chinese: 按种族分割该共和国的计划

evaluate.english: It can be difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments.
evaluate.chinese: 要对各种治疗方法的效果作出评估会很难。

evaluate.english: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
evaluate.chinese: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

evaluation.english: We need to carry out a proper evaluation of the new system.
evaluation.chinese: 我们要对新系统进行合理的评估。

evaluation.english: They took some samples of products for evaluation.
evaluation.chinese: 他们抽取了一些产品样本以作评估。

evaporate.english: The sun evaporates moisture on the leaves.
evaporate.chinese: 太阳会蒸发叶子上的水分。

evaporate.english: Most of the water had evaporated.

even.english: He became quite successful and even appeared on a television show once.
even.chinese: 他相当成功，甚至还上了一次电视节目。

even.english: Most companies have suffered a drop in their profits, even very large companies.
even.chinese: 大多数公司的利润都出现下滑，甚至连很大的公司也不例外。

evening.english: We had just finished our evening meal when the doorbell rang.
evening.chinese: 我们刚吃完晚饭门铃就响了。

evening.english: It was early evening by the time we got home.
evening.chinese: 我们到家时已经是傍晚了。

evenly.english: The profits will be split evenly between the three of us.
evenly.chinese: 利润将由我们三人平分。

evenly.english: ‘I warned you not to phone me, ’ he said evenly.
evenly.chinese: “我告诫过你不要给我打电话。”他平静地说。

event.english: one of the most important events in the history of mankind
event.chinese: 人类历史上最重大的事件之一

eventually.english: He eventually escaped and made his way back to England.
eventually.chinese: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

eventually.english: Eventually, she got a job and moved to London.
eventually.chinese: 最终，她找到了工作并移居伦敦。

ever.english: If you’re ever in Seattle, come and see me.
ever.chinese: 如果你什么时候到了西雅图，就来看我吧。

ever.english: I don’t think I’ve ever been here before.
ever.chinese: 我觉得我以前从未到过这里。

everlasting.english: a symbol of God’s everlasting love

every.english: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
every.chinese: 他说的每句话都会被细查。

everyday.english: Describe it in ordinary everyday language.
everyday.chinese: 用一般的日常语言把它描述一下。

everyone.english: Of course everyone else thought it was hilarious!
everyone.chinese: 当然其他所有人都觉得好笑极了！

everyone.english: Send my best wishes to everyone in the family.
everyone.chinese: 请向全家人致以最美好的祝愿。

everything.english: Apart from the bus arriving late, everything else seemed to be going according to plan.
everything.chinese: 除了公共汽车晚点之外，其他一切似乎都在按计划进行。

everything.english: Everything was covered in a thick layer of dust.
everything.chinese: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

everywhere.english: The south should remain dry, but everywhere else will have heavy rain.
everywhere.chinese: 南部持续干旱，但其他地区会下暴雨。

everywhere.english: I’ve looked everywhere but I can’t find the map.
everywhere.chinese: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

evidence.english: Murrow’s evidence was enough to convict Hayes of murder.
evidence.chinese: 默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

evident.english: Bob ate his lunch with evident enjoyment.
evident.chinese: 显然鲍勃吃午饭吃得津津有味。

evidently.english: Evidently, the builders had finished and gone home early.
evidently.chinese: 很明显，建筑工人干完活后早早回家了。

evidently.english: She was evidently upset by what she saw.
evidently.chinese: 她显然对所见到的事情感到不快。

evil.english: an evil dictator responsible for the deaths of millions
evil.chinese: 应对数百万人之死负责的邪恶独裁者

evil.english: She wanted to protect her children from the evils of the outside world.
evil.chinese: 她想保护她的孩子不受外界的不良影响。

evoke.english: His appearance is bound to evoke sympathy.
evoke.chinese: 他的外表肯定会引起人们的同情。

evoke.english: The photographs evoked strong memories of our holidays in France.
evoke.chinese: 那些照片勾起了我们到法国度假的深刻回忆。

evolutionary.english: Some scientists have rejected evolutionary theory.
evolutionary.chinese: 有些科学家拒绝接受进化论。

evolve.chinese: 各项业务需要快速发展。

evolve.english: Animals have evolved camouflage to protect themselves from predators.
evolve.chinese: 动物进化形成了伪装，以保护自身不被捕食性动物所捕食。

exact.english: Some concepts in Chinese medicine have no exact equivalent in Western medicine.
exact.chinese: 中医的一些概念在西医中没有完全一样的对应观念。

exact.english: Police are still investigating the exact cause of the accident.
exact.chinese: 警方还在调查这起事故的确切原因。

exactly.english: The figures may not be exactly right, but they’re close enough.
exactly.chinese: 那些数字可能不是非常精确，但也相当接近。

exaggerate.english: I couldn’t sleep for three days – I’m not exaggerating.
exaggerate.chinese: 我三天没睡觉了——一点不夸张。

exaggeration.english: It is no exaggeration to say that everyone will be affected by the new policy.
exaggeration.chinese: 说人人都会受到新政策的影响一点也不夸张。

exaggeration.english: The situation can be described, without exaggeration, as disastrous.
exaggeration.chinese: 可以毫不夸张地说，这是灾难性的局面。

exam.english: At the end of each level, there’s an exam.
exam.chinese: 在每一级别结束时都有一次考试。

exam.english: How did you do in your exams?

examination.english: The examination results will be announced in September.
He’s already taken the entrance examination.
examination.chinese: 他已经参加了入学考试。

examine.english: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
examine.chinese: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

household.chinese: 越来越多的家庭拥有至少一台电脑。

housewife.english: Married at nineteen, she was a traditional housewife and mother of four children.
housewife.chinese: 她19岁就结婚了，是个传统的家庭主妇和4个孩子的母亲。

housing.english: a scheme to provide affordable housing for local people
housing.chinese: 为当地民众提供平价住宅的计划

housing.chinese: 住房条件差引起的健康问题

hover.english: Her younger brother hovered in the background watching us.
hover.chinese: 她的弟弟在后面走来走去，观察着我们。

hover.chinese: 盘旋在水面上方的苍蝇

how.english: They had a number of suggestions as to how the service could be improved.
how.chinese: 他们有一些关于如何改进服务的建议。

how.chinese: 这仍然没有解决如何为地方公共服务业提供资金的问题。

however.english: This is a cheap and simple process. However, there are dangers.
however.chinese: 这是个花钱少而又简单的方法，不过有危险。

however.english: an extremely unpleasant disease that is, however, easy to treat
however.chinese: 一种让人极其难受却容易治疗的病

howl.english: The dog let out a savage howl and, wheeling round, flew at him.
howl.chinese: 狗发出凶猛的嗥叫声，转过身向他猛扑过来。

howl.english: He let out a howl of anguish.
howl.chinese: 他发出一声痛苦的嚎叫。

hub.english: the commercial hub of the region

huddle.english: Off to one side, Sticht, Macomber, Jordan, and Kreps huddled to discuss something.
huddle.chinese: 史蒂希特、麦康伯、乔丹和克雷普斯走到一边，私下商量起事情。

huddle.english: The president has been huddling with his most senior aides.
huddle.chinese: 总统一直在和他的顶级高级助理们秘密地聚到一起进行商谈。

hug.english: Paul gave me a big hug.
She went to her daughter and hugged her tightly .
hug.chinese: 她走到女儿身边，紧紧地拥抱她。

huge.english: These shoes make my feet look huge.
huge.chinese: 这双鞋让我的脚看上去大极了。

huge.english: Your room’s huge compared to mine.
huge.chinese: 你的房间跟我的比很大。

hum.english: He began to hum a tune.

human.english: There are many different cell types in the human body .
human.chinese: 人体中有许多种不同的细胞类型。

human.english: The desire for joy lies deep within the human spirit .
human.chinese: 对快乐的渴求藏在人类心灵深处。

humanistic.english: Religious values can often differ greatly from humanistic morals.
humanistic.chinese: 宗教价值观常常和人文主义道德观相去甚远。

humanitarian.english: The well-known humanitarian, Joseph Rowntree, was concerned with the welfare of his employees.
humanitarian.chinese: 著名的人道主义者约瑟夫.荣特里非常关心其雇员的福利。

humanitarian.english: Humanitarian aid is being sent to the refugees.
humanitarian.chinese: 正向难民提供人道主义援助。

humanity.english: We want a clean healthy environment for all humanity .
humanity.chinese: 我们希望全人类拥有一个干净健康的生存环境。

humanity.english: We must never forget our common humanity.
humanity.chinese: 我们永远不要忘记共同的人性。

humid.english: Tokyo is extremely humid in mid-summer.

humidity.english: The room is kept at 72 degrees and 50% relative humidity.
humidity.chinese: 房间的温度保持在72度，相对湿度50%。

humorous.english: The film has some mildly humorous moments.
humorous.chinese: 那部电影中有些略显幽默的片段。

humour.english: The host puts the contestants at ease with his own brand of humour .
humour.chinese: 主持人以他别具一格的幽默让参赛者放松心情。

humour.english: He showed flashes of humor that delighted the audience.
humour.chinese: 他不时冒出些幽默话逗得观众忍俊不禁。

hundred.chinese: 我不能完全确定她住在哪里。

hunger.english: Try to satisfy your hunger by eating some fruit.

hungry.english: If you get hungry , there’s some cold chicken in the fridge.
hungry.chinese: 你要是饿了，冰箱里有些冷鸡肉。

hungry.english: I was cold, tired, and hungry.

hunt.english: The couple had helped in the hunt for the toddlers.
hunt.chinese: 这对夫妇曾帮着寻找那些蹒跚学步的孩子。

hunt.english: A forensic team was hunting for clues.
hunt.chinese: 法医小组正在搜寻线索。

hurl.english: She wanted to hurl herself into his arms.

hurl.chinese: 他抓起一把椅子扔向片场的那头，把灯和花瓶都砸得粉碎。

hurricane.english: Our love is not fierce, not hot, but despite the tsunami hurricane, also vowed.
hurricane.chinese: 我们的爱，不剧烈，不炙热，可是任凭海啸飓风，也矢志不渝。

hurricane.english: I still remember a hurricane that hit us thirty years ago.
hurricane.chinese: 我还记得三十年前袭击我们的一次飓风。

hurry.english: We’ll have to hurry, otherwise we’ll miss the start.
hurry.chinese: 我们得赶紧，否则就会错过开头部分了。

hurry.english: There’s no need to hurry. We’ve got plenty of time.
hurry.chinese: 不必匆忙，我们有的是时间。

hurt.english: Put that thing down - you might hurt someone with it.
hurt.chinese: 快把那东西放下，你会伤着别人的。

hurt.english: Was anyone hurt in the accident?

husband.english: Have you met my husband Roy?
husband.chinese: 你见过我的丈夫罗伊吗？

hush.english: A sudden hush fell over the crowd.
hush.chinese: 人群突然变得鸦雀无声。

hush.english: Hush, now. Try to get to sleep.
hush.chinese: 嘘，别哭了。 好好睡吧。

hustle.english: We need to hustle if we’re going to make this flight.
hustle.chinese: 要想搭乘这趟班机，我们得抓紧时间。

hydrogen.english: The first bubbles to escape from the liquid are a mixture of air and hydrogen.
hydrogen.chinese: 从该液体中最先逸出的气泡是空气和氢的混合物。

hydrogen.english: Water can be reduced to oxygen and hydrogen by electrolysis.
hydrogen.chinese: 水通过电解可以分解为氧和氢。

hymn.english: He liked to sing hymns as he worked.
hymn.chinese: 他工作时喜欢唱赞美诗。

hypothesis.english: One hypothesis is that the victim fell asleep while driving.
hypothesis.chinese: 一种假设是受害人开车时睡着了。

hysterical.english: Everyone in the studio burst into hysterical laughter .
hysterical.chinese: 演播室里的每个人都爆发出一阵狂笑。

hysterical.english: Janet became hysterical and began screaming.
hysterical.chinese: 珍妮特歇斯底里起来，开始尖叫。

i.english: My husband and I enjoy going to the theatre.
i.chinese: 我和丈夫喜欢去剧院看戏。

i.english: I moved to this city six years ago.
i.chinese: 六年前我搬到了这个城市。

ice.english: The city spent $7 million to remove snow and ice from the roads.
ice.chinese: 市政府花费了700万美元用于清除路上的冰雪。

ice.english: Would you like some ice in your drink?
ice.chinese: 你饮料中要放点冰块吗？

icy.english: The bath water was icy cold.

idea.english: I knew it was a bad idea to leave him on his own.
idea.chinese: 我知道把他独自留下不是个好主意。

idea.english: It was my wife’s idea to move house.
idea.chinese: 要搬家是我妻子的主意。

ideal.english: The scheme offers an ideal opportunity for youngsters to get training.
ideal.chinese: 该计划为年轻人提供了获得培训的极好机会。

ideal.english: With so much rain, conditions are far from ideal.
ideal.chinese: 雨水这么多，天气情况很不理想。

idealism.english: the idealism of the younger generation

ideally.english: Fruit and vegetables should ideally be organically grown.
ideally.chinese: 水果和蔬菜最理想的应该是有机种植。

ideally.english: Ideally, your car should have high-security locks.
ideally.chinese: 最理想的情况是，你的车应该配有高度安全的车锁。

identification.english: His body was taken to Brighton mortuary for identification.
identification.chinese: 他的尸体被送到布赖顿停尸所确认身份。

identification.english: fingerprinting as a means of identification
identification.chinese: 作为一种身份证明方式的指纹提取

identify.english: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
identify.chinese: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

identify.english: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
identify.chinese: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

identity.english: The identity of the killer is still unknown.

ideological.english: The party is split by ideological differences.
ideological.chinese: 意识形态上的差异造成该政党分裂。

ideology.english: a new ideology based on individualism
ideology.chinese: 基于个人主义的新思想体系

ideology.chinese: 法西斯主义和恐怖主义的意识形态

idle.chinese: 整队人干站着等技工来。

idle.chinese: 最近六个月工人们都很闲。

idleness.english: After a period of enforced idleness, she found a new job.
idleness.chinese: 她在被迫闲散了一段时间之后，找到了份新工作。

if.chinese: 只有在操作员输入一组六位数密码后，导弹才能发射。

if.chinese: 我想明天我能修好它，如果不行，你只好等到周五了。

ignite.english: The bombs ignited a fire which destroyed some 60 houses.
ignite.chinese: 炸弹引起了一场火灾，烧毁了大约六十间房屋。

ignorance.english: Excuse my ignorance, but how does it actually work?
ignorance.chinese: 请原谅我的无知，它究竟是如何运作的？

ignore.english: You can’t ignore the fact that many criminals never go to prison.
ignore.chinese: 你不能无视很多罪犯从未获刑的事实。

ignore.english: problems which we can’t afford to ignore
ignore.chinese: 我们不能置之不理的问题

ill.english: I was feeling ill that day and decided to stay at home.
ill.chinese: 我那天不太舒服，决定留在家里。

ill.english: a hospice for the terminally ill

illegal.english: They were involved in illegal activities.

illiterate.english: A large percentage of the population is illiterate.
illiterate.chinese: 文盲人口占有相当高的比例。

illness.english: ways to improve your health and reduce the risk of illness
illness.chinese: 增进健康减少疾病的方法

illness.english: Her mother was recovering from a serious illness.
illness.chinese: 她母亲重病后正在逐渐康复。

illuminate.english: The report illuminated the difficult issues at the heart of science policy.
illuminate.chinese: 报告阐明了科学方针核心部分的难点。

illuminate.english: At night the canals are beautifully illuminated.
illuminate.chinese: 晚上运河灯火辉煌，美景毕现。

illusion.english: The mirrors in the room gave an illusion of greater space.
illusion.chinese: 房间里的镜子给人一种空间增大的错觉。

illusion.english: It is an illusion that the Arctic is dark in winter.
illusion.chinese: 认为北极冬天一片黑暗是错误的。

illustrate.english: Let me give an example to illustrate the point.
illustrate.chinese: 让我举个例子来说明这一点。

illustrate.english: She illustrated her discussion with diagrams.
illustrate.chinese: 她用图表来说明她的论述。

illustration.english: The book contains 62 pages of illustrations.

image.english: He had the clearest image in his mind of his mother and father.
image.chinese: 他脑海中对父母的印象极其清晰。

imaginary.english: We must protect older people from harm, whether it is real or imaginary.
imaginary.chinese: 我们必须保护老人免受伤害，无论这伤害是真实的还是假想的。

imaginary.chinese: 她边听边在膝盖上作弹钢琴状。

imagination.english: With a little imagination, you can find great inexpensive gifts.
imagination.chinese: 稍微动点脑筋，你就会找到物美价廉的礼物。

imagination.english: It does not take much imagination to understand their grief.
imagination.chinese: 不难想象他们是多么悲伤。

imaginative.english: an imaginative solution to the litter problem
imaginative.chinese: 解决乱扔垃圾的问题的有创意的方法

imaginative.english: an imaginative use of computer technology

imagine.english: Perhaps she’d never really been there at all – perhaps she’d just imagined it.
imagine.chinese: 可能她从未到过那儿——也许这都是她的幻想。

imitate.english: She was a splendid mimic and loved to imitate Winston Churchill.
imitate.chinese: 她是个出色的模仿者，喜欢模仿温斯顿·丘吉尔。

imitation.english: She wore an imitation of a sailor’s hat.
imitation.chinese: 她戴着一顶仿制的水手帽。

imitation.english: The remake of ‘Casablanca’ was a pale imitation (= something that is much less good than the thing it imitates ) of the original movie.
imitation.chinese: 重拍的《卡萨布兰卡》远不如原版。

immeasurable.english: The refugee problem has now reached immeasurable proportions.
immeasurable.chinese: 难民问题现在已经到了无法估量的程度。

immediate.english: If the eyes are affected, seek immediate medical attention.
immediate.chinese: 如果眼睛感染了要立即就医。

immediate.english: Our immediate response to the attack was sheer horror.
immediate.chinese: 我们对攻击的第一反应就是非常惊恐。

immediately.english: Those most immediately involved in the disaster will be given support.
immediately.chinese: 灾害最直接受害者将获得援助。

immediately.chinese: 拌入余下的食材，立即上桌。

immense.english: Regular visits from a social worker can be of immense value to old people living alone.
immense.chinese: 对于独居老人来说社工的经常探望很重要。

immense.english: People who travel by rail still read an immense amount.
immense.chinese: 人们坐火车旅行时仍然会读很多书。

immensely.chinese: 香槟酒在18世纪十分流行。

immerse.english: He left school at 16 and immersed himself in the Labour Party.
immerse.chinese: 他16岁离开学校投身工党。

immigrant.english: a new wave of immigrants from the Middle East
immigrant.chinese: 来自中东的一股新兴的移民浪潮

immigrate.english: His father and mother immigrated when he was two.
immigrate.chinese: 他的父母在他两岁时移民到这里。

immigration.english: He called for a common European policy on immigration.
immigration.chinese: 他要求欧洲国家实施共同的移民政策。

imminent.english: A new trade agreement is imminent.
imminent.chinese: 一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

immobile.english: She could see a figure sitting immobile, facing the sea.
immobile.chinese: 她看到一个人影面朝大海坐着，一动不动。

immortal.english: Plato believed that the soul is immortal.

immune.english: Once we’ve had the disease, we’re immune for life.
immune.chinese: 我们一旦得过这种病，就获得了终身免疫力。

impact.english: They say they expect the meeting to have a marked impact on the future of the country.
impact.chinese: 他们说期望这次会议对国家的未来产生显著的影响。

impact.english: The force of the impact knocked the breath out of her.
impact.chinese: 撞击力使她喘不过气来。

impair.english: The illness had impaired his ability to think and concentrate.
impair.chinese: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

impart.english: Use a piece of fresh ginger to impart a East Asian flavour to simple ingredients.
impart.chinese: 用一片鲜姜给简单的原料添上东亚的风味。

impart.english: She had information that she couldn’t wait to impart.
impart.chinese: 她得到了消息，迫不及待地想告诉别人。

impartial.english: We offer impartial advice on tax and insurance.
impartial.chinese: 我们就税收和保险问题提供公充的建议。

impartial.english: an impartial inquiry into the deaths
impartial.chinese: 对死亡事件的公正调查

impatient.english: One thing I’ve noticed is that when people have to wait, they become impatient or uncomfortable.
impatient.chinese: 我注意到一件事，就是当人们在等待的时候，人们会变的没有耐心、焦躁不安。

impatient.english: The impatient drivers were beeping their horns.
impatient.chinese: 不耐烦的司机们在按喇叭发嘟嘟声。

imperative.english: It is imperative that politicians should be good communicators.
imperative.chinese: 政治家应该是很好的沟通者，这很重要。

imperial.english: Britain’s imperial expansion in the 19th century

impermanent.english: single-storey structures, built from cheap and impermanent materials
impermanent.chinese: 用廉价而不耐久的材料建成的单层建筑

impetus.english: The discovery gave fresh impetus to the research.
impetus.chinese: 这个发现为研究带来新动力。

implement.english: We have decided to implement the committee’s recommendations in full.
implement.chinese: 我们已决定全面实施委员会提出的建议。

implement.english: The government promised to implement a new system to control financial loan institutions.
implement.chinese: 政府许诺要实施新的制度来控制金融贷款机构。

implementation.english: They do, however, greatly affect the implementation of those patterns.
implementation.chinese: 然而，它们的确对那些模式的 实现影响很大。

implementation.english: If I now scroll down to the actual implementation, now does this work or not work?
implementation.chinese: 如果现在我向下滚动到实际的执行中，这个是可用的还是不可用的呢？

implication.chinese: 它们被称作“超级电车”，这是暗指它们比先前的型号更先进。

import.chinese: 您可以输出这个轮廓，这样其他用户仅仅只需要输入这个轮廓即可。

import.chinese: 2001年英国的汽车出口量大于进口。

importance.english: He was full of his own importance (= he behaved in an annoying way which showed that he thought he was very important ).

important.english: It’s vitally important that you understand the danger.
important.chinese: 了解危险所在是极为重要的。

important.english: The accident taught him an important lesson.
important.chinese: 那次事故给了他很大的教训。

impose.english: parents who impose their own moral values on their children
impose.chinese: 把自己的道德观强加给孩子的父母

impose.english: The court can impose a fine.
impose.chinese: 法庭可以强制执行罚款。

impossible.english: Members with young children often found it impossible to attend evening meetings.
impossible.chinese: 有小孩的会员常觉得没法参加晚上的聚会。

impossible.english: Such mental attitudes are difficult, if not impossible, to change.
impossible.chinese: 即使有可能，要改变这样的心态也是很难的。

impress.english: Steve borrowed his dad’s sports car to impress his girlfriend.
impress.chinese: 史蒂夫借来他爸爸的跑车向女友炫耀。

impress.english: ‘He’s a lawyer?’ Mum looked suitably impressed (= as impressed as you would expect ).
impress.chinese: “他是个律师？”妈妈看上去果然对他印象颇好。

impression.english: When we looked around the school we got a very good impression.
impression.chinese: 我们参观了学校，对它的印象很好。

impression.english: I got the impression that she wasn’t very happy with her job.
impression.chinese: 我有这样的印象，她的工作干得并不愉快。

impressive.english: Among the guests was an impressive array of authors and critics.
impressive.chinese: 来宾中有不少出色的作家和评论家。
这些数字看上去确实很可观。

imprison.english: The government imprisoned all opposition leaders.
imprison.chinese: 政府把反对派领导人全部监禁起来。

imprison.english: She was imprisoned within his strong arms.
imprison.chinese: 她被他强壮的手臂搂着。

improper.english: It would be improper of me to comment before the election outcome is known.
improper.chinese: 在选举结果未知的情况下我作出评论是不恰当的。

improper.english: 25 officers were investigated following allegations of improper conduct.
improper.chinese: 25名警官被指控行为不当而受到调查。

improve.english: a course for students wishing to improve their English
improve.chinese: 为想提高英语水平的学生开设的一门课

improve.english: Many wines improve with age (= get better as they get older ).
improve.chinese: 很多葡萄酒年代越久越香醇。

improvement.english: Our results have shown some improvement this month.
improvement.chinese: 我们的成绩这个月有所提高。

impulse.english: It is the passions which provide the main impulse of music.
impulse.chinese: 激情是音乐创作的主要动力。

impulse.english: The eye converts light signals to nerve impulses.
impulse.chinese: 眼睛把光信号转变成神经冲动。

impulsive.english: Rosa was impulsive and sometimes regretted things she’d done.
impulsive.chinese: 罗莎性情鲁莽，有时会为做过的事感到后悔。

menace.chinese: 日益严重的海洋石油污染

menace.english: There was menace in his voice.

mend.english: If he doesn’t mend his ways, he’ll be asked to leave.
mend.chinese: 如果他不好好改改，会让他走人的。

mend.english: My father used to mend our shoes.
mend.chinese: 我父亲过去常为我们修补鞋子。

mental.english: The centre provides help for people suffering from mental illness .
mental.chinese: 该中心对精神病患者提供帮助。

mental.chinese: 压力对身体健康和心理健康都有影响。

mention.chinese: 必须说明的是他们仅研究了几个个案。

mention.english: As I mentioned earlier , there have been a lot of changes recently.
mention.chinese: 正如我刚才所说的，最近变化很大。

menu.english: Could we have the menu, please?

merchandise.english: A range of official Disney merchandise was on sale.
merchandise.chinese: 一系列正版的迪士尼商品在出售。
他们仔细地检查了商品。

merchant.english: He had a job with an Edinburgh wine merchant.
merchant.chinese: 他在爱丁堡的一个葡萄酒商那里做过事。

merchant.english: the son of a wealthy merchant

merciful.chinese: 仁慈的上帝，救救我们吧。

mercury.english: He said that all metals were composed of mercury and sulphur in different proportions .
mercury.chinese: 他说一切金属都是由水银和硫黄按不同比例构成的。

mercury.english: Some thieves have eaten off their irons with mercury water.
mercury.chinese: 有些窃贼用汞水腐蚀他们的镣铐。

mercy.english: He showed no mercy to his enemies.
God have mercy on his soul.

mere.english: She lost the election by a mere 20 votes.

merely.english: He’s merely a boy – you can’t expect him to understand.
merely.chinese: 他只是个孩子——你不要指望他能理解。

merge.english: The company plans to merge its subsidiaries in the US.
merge.chinese: 该公司计划合并其在美国的几家子公司。

merit.english: The merit of the report is its realistic assessment of the changes required.
merit.chinese: 这份报告的优点就是它对所要求的变动进行了实事求是的评估。

merit.english: The results have been encouraging enough to merit further investigation.
merit.chinese: 结果令人振奋，值得进一步调查研究。

merry.english: He marched off, whistling a merry tune.
merry.chinese: 他吹着一首欢快的曲子大步走了。

mesh.english: The windows were covered in wire mesh to keep out flies.
mesh.chinese: 窗户上装了铁丝纱网，防止苍蝇飞入。

mess.english: You can make cookies if you promise not to make a mess in the kitchen.
mess.chinese: 如果你答应不把厨房搞得乱七八糟，你可以去做甜饼。

mess.english: When I got home, the house was a complete mess .
mess.chinese: 我回到家时，屋子里一片狼藉。

message.english: The message of the film is that good always triumphs over evil.
message.chinese: 这部电影的主题思想是善良终必战胜邪恶。

message.english: He left a message saying he would probably be a little late.
message.chinese: 他留言说可能会晚一点来。

messenger.english: There will be a messenger at the airport to collect the photographs from our courier.
messenger.chinese: 机场会有一名信使从我们的快递员那儿取走照片。

metabolic.english: Exercise can increase your metabolic rate.
metabolic.chinese: 运动可以提高新陈代谢率。

metabolic.english: the metabolic activity of the brain

metal.english: The gate is made of metal.
metal.chinese: 这扇大门是用金属做成的。

metal.english: The old trucks were sold as scrap metal (= old metal that is melted and used again ) .
metal.chinese: 这些旧卡车被当作金属废料卖掉了。

metallic.english: The pans made a metallic clatter as they crashed to the floor.
metallic.chinese: 那些锅哐啷一声摔到地上。

metallic.english: The key turned in the lock with a loud metallic click.
metallic.chinese: 钥匙在锁里转动发出金属撞击的咔嗒声。

metallurgy.english: He studied metallurgy as a mature student, having spent ten years working in a foundry.
metallurgy.chinese: 在一家铸造厂工作了10年以后,他成为成人学生学习冶金专业。

metallurgy.english: Was he right to change from Physics to Metallurgy?
metallurgy.chinese: 他由学物理改为学冶金是正确的吗 ?

meter.english: The taxi driver left the meter running while I ran in to pick up my bags.
meter.chinese: 我跑进去拿行李时，出租车司机让计价器继续走字。

meter.english: A man came to read the electricity meter .

method.english: I think we should try again using a different method.
method.chinese: 我想我们应该用不同的方法再试一次。

method.english: effective methods for the storage and retrieval of information
method.chinese: 信息存储和检索的有效方法

metric.english: The parts all come in metric sizes now.
metric.chinese: 现在配件都采用公制规格。

metropolitan.english: a metropolitan area of South Australia
metropolitan.chinese: 南澳大利亚的一个都市区

microcomputer.english: The merchant sold electrical appliances, such as microcomputer, microphone, microprocessor and microwave ovens.
microcomputer.chinese: 商人卖一些电器，比如微型计算机，话筒，微处理器和微波炉。

microcomputer.english: Or, as in my case, turning on the old antique microcomputer to read my single-sided, single-density floppies might lead to a fire and the quick end of your weekend data retrieval project.
microcomputer.chinese: 或者，像我所作的那样，打开一个旧的古董微型计算机来读取我的单面单密度磁盘，而这有可能引起一场火灾，以及你的周末数据检索计划的快速完结。

microphone.english: She spoke confidently into the microphone.
microphone.chinese: 她自信地对着麦克风说话。

microphone.english: They searched the room for hidden microphones.
microphone.chinese: 他们在屋里翻找隐藏的话筒。

microprocessor.english: A microprocessor will check for interrupts at the end of every instruction.
microprocessor.chinese: 微处理器将在每一个指令末尾检查有无中断.

microprocessor.english: I've got a typerwriter with a microprocessor.
microprocessor.chinese: 我有一台装有微处理机的打字机。

microscope.english: Bacteria under the microscope, even those with no flagella, often bounce about in the water.
microscope.chinese: 在显微镜下，细菌，甚至包括那些没有鞭毛的细菌，经常在水中跳来跳去。

microscope.english: The microscope capacitates small objects to be observed.
microscope.chinese: 显微镜可以观察到微小的物体。

microscopic.english: The cells were identified through microscopic analysis.
microscopic.chinese: 那些细胞通过显微镜分析被识别出来。

microwave.english: Its molecules can be agitated by microwave energy.
microwave.chinese: 微波能量可以使其分子随之运动。

midday.english: We stopped off in Colchester for our midday meal .
midday.chinese: 我们中途在科尔切斯特停留吃了午饭。

midday.english: the full heat of the midday sun

middle.english: There are plenty of small houses for sale, and quite a lot of very large ones, but very little in the middle.
middle.chinese: 在售的小房子很多，大房子也有不少，但是不大不小的很少。

midnight.english: He’s gone for a midnight swim.
By the time he arrived, it was well past midnight (= after midnight ) .
midnight.chinese: 他到的时候早已经是后半夜了。

midst.english: We were sitting in the midst of an elegant and well-dressed audience.
midst.chinese: 我们坐在一群举止优雅、衣着考究的观众中间。

midst.english: I fear we have an enemy in our midst.
midst.chinese: 我担心我们中间有内奸。

might.english: I thought we might go to the new Chinese restaurant on the High Street.
might.chinese: 我想我们可以到大街上新开的那家中国餐馆去。

might.english: If you need more information, you might try the Internet.
might.chinese: 如果你需要更多的信息，可以试试因特网。

migrant.english: The government divides asylum seekers into economic migrants and genuine refugees.
migrant.chinese: 政府将寻求政治庇护的人划分为经济移民和真正的难民。

migrate.english: People migrate to cities like Jakarta in search of work.
migrate.chinese: 人们移居到雅加达这样的城市找工作。

migration.english: Because of this and other differences in the two versions, we recommend that you test the maps after migration.
migration.chinese: 由于这两个版本之间的种种差异，我们建议您在完成迁移后对映射进行测试。

mild.english: We had an exceptionally mild winter last year.
mild.chinese: 去年冬天我们这里异常暖和。

mile.english: We walked about half a mile .
It’s 40 miles from here to the Polish border.
mile.chinese: 从这里到波兰边界有40英里。

milestone.english: He said the launch of the party represented a milestone in Zambian history.
milestone.chinese: 他说该党的成立代表着赞比亚历史上的一个里程碑。

militant.english: After the assassination of Martin Luther King, black leaders became more militant.
militant.chinese: 马丁•路德•金遇刺后，黑人领袖变得更为激进了。

militant.english: Even now we could not be sure that the militants would not find some new excuse to call a strike the following winter.
militant.chinese: 即使到现在，我们也不能确定这些激进分子不会找到某个新的借口在下一年冬天号召一场罢工。

military.english: The United States is prepared to use military force to achieve its aims.
military.chinese: 美国准备动用武力达成目的。

military.english: The government has threatened to take military action if the rebels do not withdraw from the area.
military.chinese: 政府警告说，如果叛乱分子不从该地区撤出，就要采取军事行动。

milk.english: Would you like some milk in your tea?

milky.english: A milky mist filled the valley.
milky.chinese: 乳白色的薄雾弥漫了山谷。

mill.english: He’s really been through the mill recently.
All our flours are milled using traditional methods.
mill.chinese: 我们所有的面粉全是用传统方法碾磨的。

millimetre.english: The creature is a tiny centipede, just 10 millimetres long.
millimetre.chinese: 那个生物是一只很小的蜈蚣，只有10毫米长。

million.english: The book sold more than a million copies.
million.chinese: 这本书售出了一百多万册。

mind.english: It is impossible to understand the complex nature of the human mind .
mind.chinese: 要想了解人类思维复杂的特性是不可能的。

mind.english: Meditation involves focusing the mind on a single object or word.
mind.chinese: 冥想需要把思想集中在一个物体或单词上。

mine.english: ‘Is that your car?’ ‘No, mine is parked over the road.’
mine.chinese: “那是你的车吗？”“不是，我的车停在路对面。”

mine.english: You’ve got good legs – mine are too thin.
mine.chinese: 你的腿很美——我的腿太细了。

miner.english: Therefore, we should be more like a miner to stand in reality, excavate off wastes, and get gold mines.
miner.chinese: 所以我们更应该像一个矿工一样为执著于现实，挖开渣滓，淘出金矿。

miner.english: A miner bought food from a makeshift shop set up in the trunk of a car near a roadblock by striking miners.
miner.chinese: 一位矿工从搭建在车厢中的临时食品店中购买食物，附近的道路都被罢工的矿工们设置了路障。

mineral.english: a country with few mineral resources
Or they could be trained to use weeds as indicators of the soil's mineral properties to help them manage nutrients.
mineral.chinese: 或者可以训练他们使用杂草作为土壤矿物属性的指示器，从而帮助他们管理营养物质。

mingle.english: Add the mint and allow the flavours to mingle.
mingle.chinese: 加入薄荷，把各种味道混合起来。

mingle.english: The sounds of laughter and singing mingled in the evening air.
mingle.chinese: 笑声和歌声交织在夜空中。

miniature.english: He looked like a miniature version of his father.
miniature.chinese: 他看上去像是他父亲的微缩版。

minibus.english: He was then taken by minibus to the military base.
minibus.chinese: 接着他被小型公共汽车带到了军事基地。

minimal.english: This is a practical course, with only a minimal amount of theory.
minimal.chinese: 这是实践课程，只有少量理论。
