minimize.chinese: 忧心忡忡的人们想把患上癌症的风险降到最低。

minimize.chinese: 正在尽最大努力减少平民伤亡。

minimum.chinese: 我们开这门课程最少要有15个学生。

minor.chinese: 他们在当地政府里只是扮演次要角色。

minor.english: We have made some minor changes to the program.
minor.chinese: 我们对那个程序做了一些小改动。

minority.english: Gaelic is still spoken in Ireland by a tiny minority.
minority.chinese: 爱尔兰仍有极少数人在说盖尔语。

mint.chinese: 皇家铸币局发行的硬币

minus.english: On the minus side, there is no free back-up service if things go wrong.
minus.chinese: 不足之处是出了问题没有免费的技术支持服务。

minus.chinese: “有什么毛病吗？”“嗯，发动机噪音很大。”

minute.chinese: 火车于八点零四分到达。

miracle.chinese: 我们奇迹般地赶上了飞机。

mirror.english: When I looked in the mirror I couldn’t believe it. I looked fantastic!
mirror.chinese: 我看着镜子简直不敢相信，我看上去棒极了！

mirror.english: We believe the polls are an accurate mirror of public opinion.
mirror.chinese: 我们相信民意测验是准确反映公众意见的一面镜子。

miscalculation.chinese: 卡普兰：呃，在海上总会有误算的风险，也有发生事故的风险。

miscalculation.chinese: 我有过数次严重的自杀企图。 有点荒唐可笑，如自杀竟会误算了施药量或者割腕合适的深度。

mischief.chinese: 他们有足够的玩具玩，暂时不会捣蛋。

misconception.chinese: 说佩吉以前极其富有，这是一个错误的看法。

miserable.english: Why do you make yourself miserable by taking on too much work?
miserable.chinese: 你为什么揽这么多活儿，把自己弄得很辛苦呢？

miserable.chinese: 自从帕特离我而去后，我十分痛苦。

misery.chinese: 我们在这里所目睹的情景是许许多多的人都生活困苦。

misfortune.chinese: 银行似乎总是从农民的不幸中获益。

misguide.chinese: 此外，他们将误导那些思想单纯的人，这将导致一个恶心循环。

misguide.chinese: 另一种行为是非欺骗性的误导或者信息不充分, 即信息披露的重大遗露.

misguided.chinese: 他的父母依然错误地认为他的常识能让他远离大的麻烦。

misinterpret.chinese: 报告的某些部分可能会被误解。

mislead.english: Don’t be misled by appearances, he’s a good worker.
mislead.chinese: 不要被表象迷惑，他工作干得挺不错的。

misled.english: Sometimes he may be “misinformed, ” or “misled by others, ” but he is never, ever, wrong.
misled.chinese: 他间或可能会“信息有误”或是“被他人误导”，但他永远不会有错。

misled.chinese: 他指出，山达基信徒听到这些之后，会有一些理由，感觉他在关于进展方面误导了听析师。

mismanagement.english: His gross mismanagement left the company desperately in need of restructuring.
mismanagement.chinese: 他处理事务的严重不当使得公司急需重组。

missing.english: We found the missing piece of the jigsaw under the chair.
missing.chinese: 我们在椅子下面找到了那块丢失的拼图。

missing.english: The keys have been missing for ages.

mission.chinese: 在阵亡之前他奉命执行过200多次军事任务。

missionary.english: My mother would still like me to be a missionary in Africa.
missionary.chinese: 我母亲还是想让我在非洲做一名传教士。

mist.english: We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.
mist.chinese: 薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。

mist.english: The mist came down off the mountains.

mistake.english: The most common mistake is to plant them too deep.
mistake.chinese: 最常见的错误就是把它们种得太深了。

mister.english: Look, Mister, we know our job, so don't try to tell us what to do.
mister.chinese: 哎，先生，我们了解自己的工作，所以你不必告诉我们该干什么。

mistress.english: The Prince had shocked society by living openly with his mistress.
mistress.chinese: 王子和他的情妇公开同居，让社会大为震惊。

mistress.english: The maid looked nervously at her mistress.
mistress.chinese: 女仆紧张地看着女主人。

misunderstand.english: Don’t misunderstand me. She’s a very nice person when you get to know her.
misunderstand.chinese: 不要误解我的意思。你了解她后就会知道她是个很好的人。

misunderstand.chinese: 雷切尔，你一定是误会她了！埃莉绝不会说那样的话。

mixture.chinese: 把混合料倒入四个小碟子里。

moan.english: She gave a little moan of pleasure.
moan.chinese: 她轻轻地发出一声快乐的呻吟。

moan.english: He moaned and groaned all the way there.
moan.chinese: 他去的一路上抱怨个没完。

mob.english: They were immediately surrounded by the mob.
mob.chinese: 他们立刻被那帮暴民包围了。

mob.english: The leadership had been criticized for giving in to mob rule (= when a mob controls the situation rather than the government or the law ) .
mob.chinese: 领导层被批评屈服于暴民统治。

mobile.chinese: 如今人们的社会地位容易改变多了。

mobility.english: It improves the strength and mobility of joints.
mobility.chinese: 它能提高关节的力量和灵活性。

mobilize.chinese: 动员大家支持罢工的宣传活动

mock.english: It’s easy for you to mock, but we put a lot of work into this play.
mock.chinese: 你讲风凉话是很轻松，但我们这出戏可是费了很大力气的。

mock.english: Opposition MPs mocked the government’s decision.
mock.chinese: 反对党议员讥笑政府的这一决策。

mode.english: Set the monitor to 256 colour mode.
mode.chinese: 把显示器调成256色彩模式。

model.english: a working model (= one with parts which move ) of a steam engine

moderate.english: Moderate exercise, such as walking, is recommended.
moderate.chinese: 建议适度锻炼，比如散步。

moderate.english: Even moderate amounts of alcohol can be dangerous.
moderate.chinese: 喝酒即使不多也会有危险。

modern.english: Such companies must change if they are to compete in the modern world .
modern.chinese: 此类公司如果想在现代社会中与别人竞争，就必须有所改变。

modern.english: They are the youngest children in modern times to face murder charges.
modern.chinese: 他们是近代面临谋杀指控儿童中年龄最小的。

modernization.english: We should all make contributions to the modernization of our country.
modernization.chinese: 我们都应该对我国的现代化作出贡献。

necessarily.chinese: 照顾老年人必定要干很多搬重物的活儿。

necessary.english: The booklet provides all the necessary information about the college.
necessary.chinese: 这本小册子提供了关于那所学院的所有必需信息。

necessary.english: The doctor says it may be necessary for me to have an operation.
necessary.chinese: 医生说我可能需要做手术。

necessitate.english: Lack of money necessitated a change of plan.
necessitate.chinese: 由于缺乏资金，只能改变计划。

necessity.english: A car is an absolute necessity if you live in the country.
necessity.chinese: 你要是住在乡下，绝对需要有辆汽车。

necessity.english: I’m afraid it’s become a matter of economic necessity.
necessity.chinese: 恐怕这已成了一个经济需求的问题。

neck.english: She had a mass of golden hair, which she wore in a coil at the nape of her neck.
neck.chinese: 她有一头金发，盘在脖子后面。

neck.english: The dog picked up the puppy and carried it by the scruff of the neck into the house.
neck.chinese: 那条狗叼住小狗的后颈，把它叼进了屋子。

need.english: Are you sure that you have everything you need?
need.chinese: 你确定需要的都有了吗？

need.english: Plants need light in order to survive.

needle.english: She carried hypodermic needles and syringes in her bag.
needle.chinese: 她包里带着皮下注射针和针筒。

needle.english: Drug users are at risk when they share needles.
needle.chinese: 吸毒者共用注射针很危险。

needless.english: The report caused needless anxiety to women who have attended the clinic.
needless.chinese: 那份报告让去那家诊所就诊过的妇女产生了不必要的忧虑。

needless.english: We need to bring to an end these needless deaths.
needless.chinese: 我们必须终止这些无谓的死亡。

negative.english: They have a uniformly negative image of the police.
negative.chinese: 他们都对警察印象不好。

negative.english: Jean rarely sounded so negative about her mother.
negative.chinese: 琼很少这么说她母亲不好。

neglect.english: She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
neglect.chinese: 她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。

neglect.english: Many of these ideas have been neglected by modern historians.
neglect.chinese: 这些观点有许多都被现代的历史学家忽略了。

negligible.english: The damage done to his property was negligible.
negligible.chinese: 对他财产造成的损失微不足道。

negotiate.english: His first aim is to get the warring parties back to the negotiating table (= discussing something ).
negotiate.chinese: 他的首要目标就是把交战各方拉回到谈判桌上。

negotiation.english: The trader was obstinate in the negotiation.
negotiation.chinese: 这个商人在谈判中拗强固执。

negro.english: "I do not accept the Negro as my equal, " Douglas said. "And I deny that he is my brother.
negro.chinese: “我不会接受黑人与我平等的思想，”道格拉斯说，“而且我拒绝把黑人当成我的兄弟。

negro.english: It meant that I, a humble Negro girl, had just as much chance as anybody in the sight and love of God.
negro.chinese: 这就意味着，我这样一个卑微的黑人女孩，也可以像其他人一样有很多机会受到上帝的关注和爱。

neighborhood.english: What happened in the factory is being whispered about the neighborhood.
neighborhood.chinese: 工厂里发生的事正在附近居民中私下传说。

neighborhood.english: Iterates may be categorized into stable and unstable sets depending on whether a neighborhood under iteration converges or diverges. Some move toward stability, others away.
neighborhood.chinese: 根据一个受迭代影响的社区是聚合还是发散，迭代可以被归类到稳定和不稳定集。有些转向稳定，有些转离。

neighbour.english: One of the neighbors complained about the noise from the party.
neighbour.chinese: 有位邻居抱怨聚会太吵。

neighbour.english: FBI agents were interviewing all their friends and neighbors.
neighbour.chinese: 联邦调查局人员正在向他们所有的朋友和邻居问话。

neighbourhood.english: Be quiet! You’ll wake up the whole neighbourhood!
neighbourhood.chinese: 安静点！ 你会把邻居全都吵醒的！

neighbouring.english: The fair attracted hundreds of people from the neighbouring towns and villages.
neighbouring.chinese: 集市吸引了邻近城镇及村庄的好几百人前来。

neither.english: She lives in retirement, neither making nor receiving visits.
neither.chinese: 她过着隐退的生活， 既不访客， 也不见客。

nephew.english: I am planning a 25th birthday party for my nephew.
nephew.chinese: 我正在为侄子筹划他25岁的生日聚会。

nerve.english: a condition which affects the nerves in the back

nervous.english: I wish you’d stop looking at me like that. You’re making me nervous.
nervous.chinese: 我希望你不要再那样看着我了，你让我紧张。

nervous.english: By the time I got into the interview I was a nervous wreck (= was extremely nervous ).
nervous.chinese: 到了面试的时候，我紧张得要命。

nest.english: In May the females build a nest and lay their eggs.
Young eagles leave the nest after only two months.
nest.chinese: 雏鹰仅仅两个月以后就会飞离鸟巢。

net.english: Bruce spends most evenings surfing the Net (= looking at information in different places on the Internet ).
net.chinese: 布鲁斯晚上大多在网上浏览信息。

net.english: We netted three fish in under an hour.
net.chinese: 不到一小时我们就网住了三条鱼。

network.english: You’re listening to the American Armed Forces Network.
network.chinese: 您正在收听的是美军广播电台。

neutral.english: The British government acted as a neutral observer during the talks.
neutral.chinese: 英国政府在会谈中扮演了中立观察员的角色。

neutral.english: I always tried to remain neutral when they started arguing.
neutral.chinese: 他们争论起来的时候我总是努力保持中立。

neutrality.english: Some of the nations declared neutrality.

neutron.english: Each atomic cluster is made up of neutrons and protons.
neutron.chinese: 每个原子团簇是由中子和质子组成的。

never.english: I’m never going back there again, not as long as I live.
never.chinese: 只要我活着，我再也不会回到那儿去。

never.english: It is never too late to give up smoking.

nevertheless.english: What you said was true. It was, nevertheless, a little unkind.
nevertheless.chinese: 你说的都是实话，只不过有点刻薄。

nevertheless.english: The news may be unexpected; nevertheless, it is true.
nevertheless.chinese: 这消息可能是出乎意料的，然而是真实的。

new.english: The hardest part of this job is understanding the new technology.
new.chinese: 这项工作最难的地方是理解新技术。

newly.english: She was young at the time, and newly married.

news.english: I hope to have some good news for you soon.
news.chinese: 我希望很快就能给你好消息。

newspaper.english: a series of newspaper articles about life in Cuba
newspaper.chinese: 刊登在报纸上的一系列关于古巴生活的文章

newspaper.english: She had read about it in the newspapers.
newspaper.chinese: 关于这件事她已经在报纸上看到了。

newsstand.english: Eight new national newspapers have appeared on the newsstands since 1981.
newsstand.chinese: 自1981年以来，有八家全国性报纸已在报摊上有售。

next.english: Grace sighed so heavily that Trish could hear it in the next room.
next.chinese: 格雷丝沉重地叹气，特蕾什在隔壁房间都听到了。

next.english: The man in the next chair was asleep.

nice.english: One of the nice things about Christmas is having all the family together.
nice.chinese: 圣诞节的一个好处是全家可以聚首一堂。

nice.english: They’ve got a very nice house.

nickname.english: Stephen earned himself the nickname Hawkeye.
nickname.chinese: 斯蒂芬得了个“鹰眼”的绰号。

nickname.english: When he got older I nicknamed him Little Alf.
nickname.chinese: 他长大些后，我给他起了绰号“小阿尔夫”。

night.english: I didn’t sleep too well last night.
It was a cold moonlit night.

nightmare.english: Years after the accident I still have nightmares about it.
nightmare.chinese: 事故发生很多年后，我依然会做噩梦。

nil.english: The new machine reduced labour costs to almost nil.
nil.chinese: 新机器把劳动成本几乎降到零。

nine.english: He’s only been in this job for nine months.
nine.chinese: 他干这份工作才九个月。

nine.english: Kay was taught by her mother till she was nine (= nine years old ).
nine.chinese: 凯一直由她妈妈教到九岁。

nineteen.english: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
I was only nineteen (= 19 years old ).

ninety.english: America was far richer in the nineties.

ninth.english: In that region, Chile went from ninth to first, overall, as Chilean mobile web use increased by 3200% over the past year.
ninth.chinese: 智利从这一地区的第九跃升到第一位，因为智利的移动网络用户在过去一年增长了 3200% 。

nitrogen.english: The plant requires nitrogen in order to make proteins.
nitrogen.chinese: 植物需要氮以便制造蛋白质。

nitrogen.english: Well, we know nitrogen has what?
nitrogen.chinese: 对于氮气我们知道什么？

no.english: If you’re asking whether I feel the same way about her, the answer is no.
no.chinese: 如果你问的是我对她是否也有相同的感觉，答案是没有。

no.english: ‘Could you help me write this?’ ‘No, sorry, I haven’t got time at the moment.’
no.chinese: “你能帮我写这个吗？”“抱歉，不行，我现在没时间。”

noble.english: It’s very noble of you to spend all your weekends helping the old folk.
noble.chinese: 你心地真好，周末的时间全都用来帮助老人。

nobody.english: I knocked on the door but nobody answered.
nobody.chinese: 我敲了敲门，但没人应门。

nod.english: I asked her if she was ready to go, and she nodded.
nod.chinese: 我问她是否已准备好出发，她点了点头。

noise.english: Try not to make a noise when you go upstairs.
noise.chinese: 上楼时尽量不要弄出声。

noise.english: Noise levels have been reduced by 20%.

noisy.english: The kids have been really noisy today.

nominal.english: Their conversion to Christianity was only nominal.
nominal.chinese: 他们只是名义上皈依了基督教。

nominal.english: the nominal head of the rebellion
nominal.chinese: 这次叛乱名义上的领导人

nominate.english: Ferraro was the first woman to be nominated for the job of vice president.
nominate.chinese: 费拉罗是第一位获得副总统职位提名的女性。

nominate.english: Next year Mr Jenks will retire and Mr Broadbent will be nominated as his replacement.
nominate.chinese: 明年詹克斯先生退休，布罗德本特先生将获任命接替他的职位。

none.english: Although these were good students, none had a score above 60.
none.chinese: 虽然这些都是好学生，但是没有一个考到60分以上。

none.english: I wish I could offer you some cake but there’s none left.
none.chinese: 我真想能请你吃些蛋糕，但一点也没剩的了。

nonetheless.english: The paintings are complex, but have plenty of appeal nonetheless.
nonetheless.chinese: 这些画复杂难懂，不过还是不乏吸引力。

nonetheless.english: The region was extremely beautiful. Nonetheless Gerard could not imagine spending the rest of his life there.
nonetheless.chinese: 那个地区非常漂亮，然而杰拉德却无法想象自己要在那里度过余生。

nonsense.english: By 1832 the idea had become an economic nonsense.
nonsense.chinese: 到了1832年，那种观点已经成为经济学的谬论。

nonsense.english: ‘I’m a prisoner in my own home.’ ‘Nonsense!’
nonsense.chinese: “我在自己家里就像个囚犯。”“胡说！”

nor.english: Hilary was neither shocked nor surprised by the news.
nor.chinese: 希拉里对这个消息既没有感到震惊，也没有觉得意外。

nor.english: Neither Matt nor Julie said anything.
nor.chinese: 马特和朱莉都没有说什么。

norm.english: Joyce’s style of writing was a striking departure from the literary norm.
norm.chinese: 乔伊斯的写作风格与传统的文学风格大相径庭。

normal.english: She was assessed in the normal way, and placed on the waiting list.
normal.chinese: 她接受了正常的评估后被列入等候名单。

normal.english: All I want is to lead a normal life.
normal.chinese: 我想要的只是能过正常的生活。

normally.english: The journey normally takes about two hours.
normally.chinese: 这段旅程通常需要大约两小时。

normally.english: Normally, I park behind the theatre.
normally.chinese: 通常我把车停在剧院后面。

northern.english: a man with a northern accent

nose.english: They went over to the aeroplane and stood near its nose.
nose.chinese: 他们朝飞机走了过去并站在靠近机头的地方。

nose.english: Someone punched him on the nose.
nose.chinese: 有人一拳打在他的鼻子上。

not.english: ‘Can we go to the park?’ ‘No, not today, dear.’
not.chinese: “我们能去公园吗？”“不，今天不行，亲爱的。”

not.english: Most of the stores do not open until 10 am.
not.chinese: 大多数商店要到上午10点才开始营业。

notable.english: Every country in the world signed the treaty, with one notable exception - the United States.
notable.chinese: 全世界每个国家都签署了那份条约，只有一个国家反其道而行之，就是美国。

notable.english: The town is notable for its busy open-air market.
notable.chinese: 该城镇因其热闹的露天市场而出名。

notably.english: Notably absent from his statement was any hint of an apology.
notably.chinese: 他的话里显然没有丝毫道歉的意思。

notably.english: Emigration has notably increased over the past five years.
notably.chinese: 在过去五年中，移居国外的人明显增加。

notation.english: Musical notation was conceived for the C major scale and each line and space represents a note in this scale.
notation.chinese: 乐谱为C大音阶而构思，在这个音阶中的每一个线和间都代表一个音符。

note.english: Can I borrow your lecture notes?
note.chinese: 我能不能借用一下你的课堂笔记？

notebook.english: He brought out a notebook and pen from his pocket.
notebook.chinese: 他从口袋里掏出了一个笔记本和一支钢笔。

nothing.english: A brief search was made but they found nothing untoward.
nothing.chinese: 他们简单地搜查了一番，没发现任何异常。

nothing.english: ‘Do you know much about business?’ ‘Nothing at all.’
nothing.chinese: “你对做生意了解得多吗？”“一窍不通。”

notice.english: He noticed a woman in a black dress sitting across from him.
notice.chinese: 他看到有位黑衣女子坐在他的对面。

noticeable.english: It was noticeable that many of them avoided answering the question.
noticeable.chinese: 显而易见，他们中的许多人对这个问题都避而不答。

noticeable.english: Alcohol has a noticeable effect on the body.
noticeable.chinese: 酒精对身体有明显的影响。

notification.english: Names of the dead and injured are being withheld pending notification of relatives.
notification.chinese: 伤亡者的姓名在通知亲属前不被公布。

notify.english: In August we were notified that our article had been rejected.
notify.chinese: 8月份我们接到通知，说我们的文章不予采用。

notify.english: The skipper notified the coastguard of the tragedy.
notify.chinese: 船长通知了海岸警卫队这一灾难。

notion.english: She had no notion what he meant.
notion.chinese: 她根本不明白他是什么意思。

notorious.english: notorious cases of human rights abuses
notorious.chinese: 臭名昭著的践踏人权案

notoriously.english: Derrida famously, notoriously, said "there is nothing outside the text," right? What he meant by that, of course, is that there's nothing but text.
notoriously.chinese: 德里达著名地，恶名昭彰地，说道，文本之外什么都没有“,是吧，当然，他意思就是说，需要考虑的只有文本。

notwithstanding.english: Fame and fortune notwithstanding, Donna never forgot her hometown.
notwithstanding.chinese: 尽管名利双收，但唐娜从未忘记自己的家乡。

notwithstanding.english: Notwithstanding differences, there are clear similarities in all of the world’s religions.
notwithstanding.chinese: 世界上的宗教尽管各不相同，但都有明显的相似之处。

nought.english: A billion is 1 with 9 noughts after it.

noun.english: In “the black cat” the adjective “black”modifies the noun “cat”.
noun.chinese: 在“那只黑猫”中，形容词“黑的”修饰名词“猫”。

noun.english: An adjective must agree with its noun in mumber and case.
noun.chinese: 形容词在数和格方面必须符合其所修饰的名词。

nourish.english: The cream contains vitamin A to nourish the skin.
nourish.chinese: 这种护肤霜含有滋养肌肤的维生素A。

nourish.english: The food she eats nourishes both her and the baby.
nourish.chinese: 她吃的食物为她和婴儿提供营养。

nourishment.english: The soil provides nourishment for plant roots.
nourishment.chinese: 土壤为植物根部提供养分。

novel.english: It took Vikram Seth three years to write his 1,349-page novel ‘A Suitable Boy’.
novel.chinese: 维克拉姆·塞斯花费三年时间写成了他那部1,349页的小说《如意郎君》。

novel.english: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices.
novel.chinese: 抗议者们找到一种新奇的示威方式来反对石油价格的飙升。

novelty.english: Many toys have no attraction beyond their novelty value.
novelty.chinese: 许多玩具除了有些新奇感之外，别无吸引力。

novelty.english: Then the Internet was still something of a novelty.
novelty.chinese: 那时因特网还是个挺新鲜的东西。

now.english: But we are now a much more fragmented society.
now.chinese: 但是我们现在是一个更加四分五裂的社会。

nowadays.english: Nowadays people are rarely shocked by the sex they see on television.
nowadays.chinese: 如今人们在电视上看见性爱镜头不太会感到吃惊了。

nowadays.english: Most people nowadays are aware of the importance of a healthy diet.
nowadays.chinese: 现在大多数人都明白健康饮食的重要性。

nowhere.english: Nowhere is drug abuse more of a problem than in the US.
nowhere.chinese: 没有什么地方的吸毒问题比美国更严重。

nucleus.english: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.
nucleus.chinese: 在一个原子的核内，中子和质子聚合在一起。

nuisance.english: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk.
nuisance.chinese: 他喝醉时会是一个有点令人讨厌的人。

number.english: They wrote various numbers on a large sheet of paper.
number.chinese: 他们在一张大纸上写下了很多不同的数字。

number.english: The crowd numbered more than a thousand.
number.chinese: 聚集的人群共计一千多人。

numerical.english: Make sure the files are organized in numerical order.
numerical.chinese: 务必把这些档案按数字顺序排列。

numerical.english: The home team tried to utilize their numerical advantage (= the fact that they had more players than the other team ).
numerical.chinese: 主队试图利用他们在人数上的优势。

numerous.english: The two leaders have worked together on numerous occasions.
numerous.chinese: 那两位领导人已经多次合作。

numerous.english: Numerous attempts have been made to hide the truth.
numerous.chinese: 为掩盖事实作了很多尝试。

nun.english: Mr. Thomas was taught by the Catholic nuns whose school he attended to work and study hard.
nun.chinese: 托马斯先生受教于天主教修女。在修女开办的学校里他专心工作，刻苦学习。

nurse.english: The nurse is coming to give you an injection.
The school nurse sent Sara home.
nurse.chinese: 学校的护士送萨拉回家。

nursery.english: The garden, developed over the past 35 years, includes a nursery.
nursery.chinese: 这个有35年历史的园子里有一个苗圃。

nursery.english: She puts her baby in this nursery and then goes back to work.
nursery.chinese: 她把孩子送到这家托儿所然后回去上班。

nut.english: Use a wrench to loosen the nut.
nut.chinese: 用活动扳手将螺帽拧松。

nut.english: We were sitting round the fire cracking nuts (= opening them ).
nut.chinese: 我们围坐在火炉边夹碎坚果。

nutrition.english: Nutrition and exercise are essential to fitness and health.
nutrition.chinese: 营养和运动是保持健康所必不可少的。

nutritious.english: The cookbook contains many simple yet highly nutritious meals.
nutritious.chinese: 那本烹饪书里有许多简单却营养价值很高的食谱。

nutritious.english: Wholemeal bread is more nutritious than white bread.
nutritious.chinese: 全麦面包比白面包更有营养。

nylon.english: The tent was made of nylon.

oar.english: He pulled as hard as he could on the oars.

oath.english: She could not break her oath .
The president took the oath of office (= made the official public promises that every president makes when starting their job ) .

obedience.english: obedience classes for dogs and their owners
obedience.chinese: 为狗和主人安排的服从训练课

obedient.english: citizens who are obedient to the law

obesity.english: Dr.Watson is great on exercise as a cure for obesity.
obesity.chinese: 沃森医生把运动看做是治疗肥胖症的良方。

obesity.english: So, what of the future of obesity in America?
obesity.chinese: 那么，未来美国的肥胖状况会怎么发展呢？

obey.english: The little boy made no effort to obey.
‘Sit!’ he said, and the dog obeyed him instantly.
obey.chinese: “坐下！”他说道，那只狗马上就服从了。

object.english: an everyday object such as a spoon
If no one objects, I would like Mrs Harrison to be present.
object.chinese: 如果没人反对的话，我想请哈里森夫人出席。

objection.english: Her objection was that he was too young.
objection.chinese: 她反对的理由是他太小。

objective.english: The main objective was to improve children’s knowledge of geography.
objective.chinese: 主要目的是要增长儿童的地理知识。

vigour.english: He began working with renewed vigour.
vigour.chinese: 他以更加旺盛的精力开始工作。

villa.english: We rented a holiday villa in Spain.
villa.chinese: 我们在西班牙租了一座假日别墅。

vine.english: Ivy is a type of vine.
vine.chinese: 常青藤是一种藤本植物。

vinegar.english: The sugared vinegar is refined from the sugarcane and pine.
vinegar.chinese: 加糖的醋是从甘蔗和松木中精炼出来的.

vinegar.english: Can we have some salt / pepper / vinegar / mustard, please?
vinegar.chinese: 可以帮我加一些盐、胡椒粉、醋、芥末吗？

violate.english: 34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
violate.chinese: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

violation.english: She accused the press photographers of violating her privacy.
violation.chinese: 她指责新闻摄影记者侵犯了她的隐私。

violence.english: She spoke with a violence that surprised them both.
violence.chinese: 她言辞激烈，令他们俩都很惊讶。

violent.english: 31 people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day.
violent.chinese: 今天一天有31人在暴力事件中受伤。

violent.english: The riots ended in the violent deaths of three teenagers.
violent.chinese: 动乱以三名少年的惨死而告终。

violet.english: She inhaled the violet perfume, saying “How sweet!”
violet.chinese: 她一边闻紫罗兰的芳香， 一边说“好香啊！”

violet.english: And what of the violet hue?
violet.chinese: 这个和紫色色调又什么关系么？

violin.english: All this from playing the violin and the cello.
violin.chinese: 所有这些都来自于小提琴和大提琴的演奏。

violin.english: She is first violin of an orchestra .
violin.chinese: 她是管弦乐队的第一小提琴手。

virgin.english: Within 40 years there will be no virgin forest left.
virgin.chinese: 过不了40年原始森林将所剩无几。

virgin.english: I was a virgin until I was thirty years old.

virtual.english: Argentina came to a virtual standstill while the game was being played.
virtual.chinese: 阿根廷在比赛进行期间全国上下事实上进入了停顿状态。

virtual.english: The website allows you to take a virtual tour of the art gallery.
virtual.chinese: 这个网站可让你对美术馆作一番虚拟参观。

virtually.english: Virtually all cooking was done over coal-fired ranges.
virtually.chinese: 事实上所有的烹饪都是在烧煤的炉灶上完成的。

virtually.english: He was virtually unknown before running for office.
virtually.chinese: 他在参加竞选之前几乎不为人知。

virtue.english: Women have often been used as symbols of virtue.
virtue.chinese: 女性常被用作美德的象征。

virus.english: children infected with the Aids virus
virus.chinese: 感染艾滋病病毒的儿童

visa.english: I was still in New York, trying to get a visa to visit Russia.
visa.chinese: 我仍在纽约，正在办理去俄罗斯的签证。

visceral.english: his visceral hatred of the ruling class
visceral.chinese: 他对统治阶级发自肺腑的仇恨

viscous.english: As the liquid cools, it becomes viscous.
viscous.chinese: 这液体冷却后会变黏稠。

visibility.english: Visibility on the roads is down to 20 metres due to heavy fog.
visibility.chinese: 道路能见度因浓雾降至20米。

visible.english: Check the plant for any visible signs of disease.
visible.chinese: 检查一下植物是否有患病的迹象。

visible.english: The comet is visible to the naked eye (= can be seen without using special equipment ).

vision.english: She suffered temporary loss of vision after being struck on the head.
vision.chinese: 她头部受撞击以后出现暂时性失明。

vision.english: Tears blurred her vision (= made it difficult for her to see ).

visit.english: Eric went to Seattle to visit his cousins.
visit.chinese: 埃里克到西雅图去看望他的表兄弟。

visual.english: The tall tower adds to the visual impact of the building.
visual.chinese: 高高的塔楼增强了这幢大楼的视觉效果。

visual.english: Artists translate their ideas into visual images.
visual.chinese: 画家把自己的思想转换成视觉画面。

visualize.english: I tried to visualize the house while he was describing it.
visualize.chinese: 我一边听他描述，一边想象那房子的样子。

vital.english: Rodgers and Hart’s music sounds as fresh and vital as the day it was written.
vital.chinese: 罗杰斯与哈特的音乐现在听来还有刚写成时的那份清新和活力。

vital.english: The tourist industry is of vital importance to the national economy.
vital.chinese: 旅游业对国家的经济至关重要。

vitality.english: Despite her eighty years, Elsie was full of vitality.
vitality.chinese: 尽管已80岁了，埃尔茜依然充满活力。

vitally.english: A sensible diet is vitally important if you want to remain in good health.
vitally.chinese: 如想保持健康，合理的饮食十分重要。

vitamin.english: If you give your child a vitamin, perhaps you should stick with this classic.
vitamin.chinese: 如果你给你的孩子服用一种维他命，可能你需要坚持这一个原则。

vitamin.english: Try to eat foods that are rich in vitamins and minerals.
vitamin.chinese: 尽量吃富含维生素和矿物质的食物。

vivid.english: He had a vivid picture of her in his mind.
vivid.chinese: 他的脑海中清晰地留着她的形象。

vivid.english: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
vivid.chinese: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

vocabulary.english: Teachers were impressed by his vocabulary.
vocabulary.chinese: 他的词汇量给老师们留下了深刻的印象。

vocal.english: Allison’s vocal style is influenced by country and blues music.
vocal.chinese: 艾利森的演唱风格受到乡村音乐和布鲁斯音乐的影响。

vocation.english: At 17 she found her true vocation as a writer.
vocation.chinese: 17岁时她找到了自己真正的使命——当一名作家。

void.english: Her eyes were void of all expression.

volcano.english: Pompeii was destroyed when the volcano erupted in 79 AD.
volcano.chinese: 庞贝城于公元79年在火山爆发中毁灭。

volt.english: If I multiply these two, what is the coulomb times a volt?
volt.chinese: 如果我把这两个乘起来，库仑乘以伏特是多少？
就是一单位的电子伏特。

voltage.english: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
voltage.chinese: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

voluntary.english: Workers are being encouraged to take voluntary redundancy.

volunteer.english: Most of the relief work was done by volunteers.
volunteer.chinese: 大部分救援工作都由志愿人员完成。

volunteer.english: I volunteered my services as a driver.

vote.english: In 1918 British women got the right to vote.

vow.english: Jim made a vow that he would find his wife’s killer.
vow.chinese: 吉姆发誓要找到杀害他妻子的凶手。

vowel.english: Each language has a different vowel system.
vowel.chinese: 每种语言都有不同的元音系统。

voyage.english: The voyage from England to India used to take six months.
voyage.chinese: 过去从英格兰到印度要航行六个月。

voyage.english: I don’t want to make the voyage single-handed.

vulnerable.english: We work mainly with the elderly and other vulnerable groups.
vulnerable.chinese: 我们主要和老年人以及其他弱势群体打交道。

vulnerable.english: He took advantage of me when I was at my most vulnerable.
vulnerable.chinese: 他在我最脆弱的时候利用了我。

wade.english: Sometimes they had to wade waist-deep through mud.
wade.chinese: 有时他们得通过齐腰深的泥浆。

wade.english: He waded into the water to push the boat out.
wade.chinese: 他蹚进水里把船推出来。

wag.english: ‘You naughty girl!’ Mom said, wagging her finger at me.
wag.chinese: “你这个调皮的丫头！”妈妈对我摇了摇手指说道。

wag.english: The dog was biting, growling and wagging its tail.
wag.chinese: 那条狗咬着叫着，还摇着尾巴。

wage.english: The government, along with the three factions that had been waging a civil war, signed a peace agreement.
wage.chinese: 政府和发动了内战的3方一起签订了1份和平协议。

waist.english: The skirt was too big around the waist.

waken.english: She gently wakened the sleeping child.
waken.chinese: 她轻轻地唤醒睡梦中的孩子。

wallet.english: He took a credit card out of his wallet.
wallet.chinese: 他从钱包里拿出一张信用卡。

walnut.english: Below in the valley lie miles of walnut trees.
walnut.chinese: 在下面的山谷里绵延着几英里的核桃树。

wander.english: Don’t let any of the kids wander off.
wander.chinese: 不要让任何一个小孩走开去。

wander.english: He was found wandering the streets of New York.
wander.chinese: 有人看到他在纽约街头游荡。

want.english: The gallery closed down for want of funding.
want.chinese: 那家画廊由于缺乏资金关闭了。

ward.english: the other patients in the ward

wardrobe.english: Can you hang these in the wardrobe, please?
wardrobe.chinese: 请你把这些衣服挂到衣橱里去好吗？

wardrobe.english: fitted/built-in wardrobes (=wardrobes built against a wall or fitted between two walls)

ware.english: He travelled from town to town selling his wares.
ware.chinese: 他走乡串镇出售自己的货品。

warehouse.english: The goods have been sitting in a warehouse for months because a strike has prevented distribution.
warehouse.chinese: 因为罢工无法发货，货物已经堆在仓库里好几个月了。

warehouse.english: The building opposite us is the warehouse.
warehouse.chinese: 我们对面的那个建筑是仓库。

warmth.english: She went further into the room, drawn by the warmth of the fire.
warmth.chinese: 她被火的温暖吸引着，走进了房间。

warning.english: a warning that grey squirrels are threatening the existence of red squirrels
warning.chinese: 关于灰松鼠正威胁到红松鼠生存的警告

warrant.english: There is no warrant for copying other people’s work.
warrant.chinese: 剽窃他人作品毫无道理。

warrant.english: The magistrate issued a warrant for his arrest.
warrant.chinese: 地方法官发出了对他的逮捕令。

wasteful.english: The software is very wasteful of memory.

watchful.english: The entrances are guarded by watchful security staff.
watchful.chinese: 入口处由警惕的保安人员把守。

water.english: When dealing with a burst pipe, always turn off the water first.
water.chinese: 处理破裂水管时，一定要先把水关掉。

water.english: Pour boiling water over the rice and let it soak.
water.chinese: 在大米中倒入沸水浸泡。

waterproof.english: Rub the wax in to make the shoe waterproof.
waterproof.chinese: 在鞋子上抹点蜡使其防水。

watertight.english: Lucky for him, his alibi is watertight.
watertight.chinese: 算他走运，不在犯罪现场的证据无懈可击。

watery.english: Her eyes were red and watery from crying.
watery.chinese: 她的眼睛哭得红红的，眼里含满泪水。

watery.english: Snakes lay eggs in a watery environment.
watery.chinese: 蛇在潮湿的环境里产卵。

wave.english: The ship tipped over, and finally vanished beneath the waves.
wave.chinese: 船倾覆了，最终沉没在海浪之下。

wave.english: Dee watched the waves breaking on the shore.
wave.chinese: 迪伊凝视着拍岸的波涛。

waver.english: The candle flame wavered, throwing shadows on the wall.
waver.chinese: 烛光摇曳，在墙上投下影子。

waver.english: Shareholders who were wavering met the directors.
waver.chinese: 举棋不定的股东们会见了董事。

way.english: It’s worth thinking how you can improve the way things are.
way.chinese: 你应该想想如何让现状变得更好。

way.english: The chicken’s nice and crispy – just the way I like it.
way.chinese: 这鸡肉很脆，正是我喜欢的口味。

weaken.english: The absence of this witness has weakened the case against the accused.
weaken.chinese: 这名证人的缺席削弱了对被告的指控力度。

weaken.english: Over the last two years the president’s position has weakened.
weaken.chinese: 过去两年来，总统的地位被削弱了。

weakness.english: The legislation has a fundamental weakness.
weakness.chinese: 这项立法有一个根本性缺陷。

weakness.english: The plan has strengths and weaknesses.
weakness.chinese: 这个计划既有优点又有缺点。

wealth.english: The purpose of industry is to create wealth.
wealth.chinese: 工业的目的就是创造财富。

wealth.english: The country’s wealth comes from its oil.
wealth.chinese: 这个国家的财富来自石油。

wealthy.english: the wealthy nations of the world

weapon.english: They all had sticks which they planned to use as weapons.
weapon.chinese: 他们都持有棍棒，打算当武器用。

wear.english: The cushions are starting to wear a little.
wear.chinese: 这些靠垫开始有点磨破了。

wear.english: His jeans have worn thin at the knees.
wear.chinese: 他牛仔裤的膝盖处已经磨薄了。

weary.english: She found Rachel in the kitchen, looking old and weary.
weary.chinese: 她发现雷切尔在厨房里，看上去苍老而疲惫。

weary.english: She sat down with a weary sigh.
weary.chinese: 她疲倦地叹口气坐了下来。

weave.english: Only a few of the women still weave.
weave.chinese: 只有数量很少的妇女还在编织。

web.english: We were caught in a tangled web of relationships.
web.chinese: 我们陷入了错综复杂的人际关系网络。

wedding.english: She’s busy planning her daughter’s wedding.
wedding.chinese: 她正忙着筹备女儿的婚礼。

wedge.english: He hammered the wedge into the crack in the stone.
wedge.chinese: 他用锤子把楔子砸入石缝里。

wedge.english: Wedge the plug into the hole.

weed.chinese: 卡斯帕正在给花园除草。

weep.chinese: 詹姆斯控制不住感情，哭了起来。

weep.english: He wept bitterly (= cried a lot ) when it was time for us to leave.
weep.chinese: 我们要分别的时候他痛哭了一场。

weird.english: A really weird thing happened last night.
weird.chinese: 昨晚发生了一件非常奇怪的事。

weld.english: The new handle will have to be welded on.

welfare.english: Our only concern is the children’s welfare.
welfare.chinese: 我们唯一关心的是孩子们的幸福。

well-known.english: This is probably their best-known song.
well-known.chinese: 这可能是他们最有名的歌曲。

whale.english: The whale nearest to the photographer is releasing air to aid its descent.
whale.chinese: 这只离摄影师最近的白鲸正呼出空气以帮助其下潜。

whale.english: This type of whale is notable for its elongated beak. It dives deeper than 500 metres for food.
whale.chinese: 这种鲸因其瘦长的喙而闻名。它能够潜入深度超过500米的海中寻找食物。

wharf.english: The ship lies alongside the wharf.

what.english: What he did was morally wrong.

whatever.english: This is just a stupid argument that has nothing whatever to do with your job.
whatever.chinese: 这只是一场无聊的争论，和你的工作没有任何关系。

whatever.english: She has shown no interest whatever in anything scientific.
whatever.chinese: 凡是与科学有关的她都没有表现出任何兴趣。

wheel.english: Shall I take the wheel (= drive instead of someone else )?

whereas.english: The old system was fairly complicated whereas the new system is really very simple.
whereas.chinese: 旧系统相当复杂，而新系统却很简单。

whereas.english: Whereas the city spent over $1 billion on its museums and stadium, it failed to look after its schools.
whereas.chinese: 这个城市花了十亿美元建造博物馆和体育馆，但是却忽略了对学校的建设。

whereby.english: a proposal whereby EU citizens would be allowed to reside anywhere in the EU
whereby.chinese: 允许欧盟公民在欧盟任何地方居住的一项提议

whichever.english: Letting taxes rise abruptly would hurt not only the recovery but also whichever party the electorate ended up blaming.
whichever.chinese: 突然的增税不但会妨害经济复苏，而且无论哪个政党这样做都会受到选民指责。

whip.english: He whipped the horse into a canter.
whip.chinese: 他抽了一下鞭子，马儿就小跑起来。

whirl.english: We watched the seagulls whirling and shrieking over the harbour.
whirl.chinese: 我们看海鸥在港口上空盘旋鸣叫。

whisper.english: You don’t have to whisper, no one can hear us.
whisper.chinese: 你不必轻声轻语，没人听得到我们说话。

whisper.english: Staff were whispering that the company was about to go out of business.
whisper.chinese: 员工私下在传，说公司要倒闭了。

whistle.english: The referee whistled and the game began.
whistle.chinese: 裁判哨声一响，比赛开始了。

whitewash.english: Investigators are accused of whitewashing the governor’s record.
whitewash.chinese: 调查者被指责粉饰州长的政绩。

whoever.english: When you’re done with the book, just give it to Kristin or Shelley or whoever.
whoever.chinese: 你看完书以后，就给克里斯廷或谢利，或者随便谁都行。

whoever.english: Whoever would do a thing like that to an old woman?
whoever.chinese: 究竟是谁会对一位老太太做出那样的事？

wholly.english: The report claimed that the disaster was wholly unavoidable.
wholly.chinese: 报告称这场灾难完全无法避免。

wicked.english: the wicked stepmother in ‘Hansel and Gretel’

widely.english: The quality of the applicants varies widely.
widely.chinese: 申请人的素质差异很大。

widen.chinese: 这条河有变宽的河段，也有分流的河段。

widespread.english: the widespread use of chemicals in agriculture
widespread.chinese: 化学品在农业中的广泛使用

widow.english: an elderly widow who was attacked and robbed last month
widow.chinese: 上个月遭到行凶抢劫的一位寡居老妇

width.english: a covered terrace extending the full width of the house
width.chinese: 和房子同宽的有顶露台

wield.english: She wields enormous power within the party.
He was attacked by a man wielding a knife.
wield.chinese: 他遭到一名持刀男子的袭击。

wildlife.english: measures to protect the area’s wildlife
wildlife.chinese: 保护该地区野生生物的措施

willing.english: I soon had an army of willing helpers.
willing.chinese: 我很快就拥有了一批热心的帮手。

willow.english: The baskets are woven from strips of willow.
willow.chinese: 这些篮子是用柳条编的。

wind.english: The wind blew from the northeast.

windmill.english: The sails of the windmill are now at rest.
windmill.chinese: 风车的帆叶现在静止不动了。

windy.english: It’s too windy for a picnic.

wing.english: The bird flapped its wings furiously.
wing.chinese: 那只鸟使劲地拍打着翅膀。

wink.english: He winked an eye at his companion.

wisdom.english: You can always expect a few words of wisdom from Dave.
wisdom.chinese: 戴夫总能冒出几句至理名言。

wise.english: I don’t think that would be a very wise move (= not be a sensible thing to do ).
wise.chinese: 我认为那样做不是很明智。

wishful.english: Stop your wishful thinking and be glad for what you do have instead of always wanting more.
wishful.chinese: 别再一厢情愿的妄想了，高高兴兴的接受你已经有的，别再奢求更多了。

wishful.english: Look to reality instead of relying on wishful thinking.
wishful.chinese: 要着眼现实，而不要依赖一厢情愿的想法。

wit.english: The information is there and waiting to be accessed by anyone with the wit to use it.
wit.chinese: 信息是现成的，等着有头脑的人去获取和利用。

wit.english: a woman of great wit and charm
wit.chinese: 说话风趣、风韵动人的女人

withdraw.english: calls for Britain to withdraw from the European Union
withdraw.chinese: 要求英国退出欧盟的呼声

wither.english: Industries unable to modernize have been left to wither.
wither.chinese: 无法实现现代化的行业已经自行衰落。

wither.english: The flowers in Isabel's room had withered.
wither.chinese: 伊莎贝尔房间里的花朵已经枯萎了。

withhold.english: Ian was accused of withholding vital information from the police.
withhold.chinese: 伊恩被控向警方隐瞒重要信息。

withhold.english: I withheld payment until they had completed the work.
withhold.chinese: 我扣着钱，直到他们完工。

withstand.english: The Chancellor has withstood the criticism and held firm.
withstand.chinese: 总理顶住批评，坚持立场。

witness.english: an eye witness (= someone who sees an event ) to the robbery
Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward.
witness.chinese: 警方呼吁目击者站出来。

woe.english: He listened to my tale of woe.

wonder.english: He’s been leaving work early a lot – it makes you wonder , doesn’t it?
wonder.chinese: 他最近经常提早下班——让人觉得奇怪，是不是？

wonder.english: What are they going to do now, I wonder ?
wonder.chinese: 我想知道，他们现在打算怎么办呢？

woodpecker.english: Savour the silence, if that's what nature serves up, or thrill to the tap-tap of the woodpecker.
woodpecker.chinese: 如果这是大自然奉上的一份佳肴，给这份宁静加点作料吧，或是因为啄木鸟的叩击声而兴奋起来吧。

woodpecker.english: A woodcutter and a woodpecker lived in the forest.
woodpecker.chinese: 森林里居住着一个樵夫和一个啄木鸟。

workload.english: She’s struggling to cope with the heavy workload .
workload.chinese: 她在努力应付繁重的工作量。

workman.english: In University Square workmen are building a steel fence.
workman.chinese: 在大学广场工人们正在筑一个钢栅栏。

workpiece.english: The workpiece is already on the lathe.

workshop.english: Trumpeter Marcus Belgrave ran a jazz workshop for young artists.
workshop.chinese: 鼓手马库斯马贝尔格瑞夫为年轻艺术家们举办了一场爵士乐研讨会。

world-wide.english: Today, doctors are fearing a worldwide epidemic.
world-wide.chinese: 如今，医生们在担心一次世界性的流行。

worldly.english: He seemed very calm and far removed from worldly concerns.
worldly.chinese: 他显得非常淡定，完全没有俗世的忧虑。

worldwide.english: His books have sold more than 20 million copies worldwide.
worldwide.chinese: 他的书在全世界卖出了两千多万本。

worsen.english: A lot of teachers expect the situation to worsen over the next few years.
worsen.chinese: 许多老师认为接下来的几年情形会更糟。

worsen.english: Interfering now could worsen the problem.
worsen.chinese: 目前介入可能会使问题更严重。

worship.english: The ceremony must take place in a recognized place of worship .
worship.chinese: 该仪式必须在获得认可的敬拜场所举行。

worship.english: a church where people have worshipped for hundreds of years
worship.chinese: 人们做了几百年礼拜的一座教堂

worst.english: What is the worst possible thing that can happen?
worst.chinese: 最糟可能会发生什么事？

worst.english: My worst fear was that we would run out of food.
worst.chinese: 我最大的担忧是我们会把食物吃光。

worth.english: You should not deprecate your own worth.
worth.chinese: 你不应该贬低你自己的价值。

worthless.english: The house was full of worthless junk.
worthless.chinese: 这房子里堆满了没有用的东西。

worthless.english: The information was worthless to me.
worthless.chinese: 这些资料对我毫无用处。

worthwhile.english: He wanted to do a worthwhile job.
We decided to give the money to a worthwhile cause (= one that helps people ) .
worthwhile.chinese: 我们决定把这笔钱投入到慈善事业中。

worthy.english: Leeds United were worthy winners of the competition.
worthy.chinese: 利兹联队是比赛当之无愧的获胜者。

wound.english: A nurse cleaned and bandaged the wound.
wound.chinese: 护士把伤口清洗包扎好。

wound.english: The doctor said it was only a flesh wound (= one that does not cut the skin very deeply ) .

wrap.english: I’ve still got a few Christmas presents to wrap up.
wrap.chinese: 我还有一些圣诞礼物要包起来。

wrath.english: He was scared of incurring his father’s wrath .
wrath.chinese: 他害怕惹他父亲大发脾气。

wreck.english: He was still alive when they pulled him from the wreck.
wreck.chinese: 他们把他从失事的车辆中拖出来时，他还活着。

wrench.english: He grabbed the rope and gave it a wrench.
I wrenched the packet from his grasp.
wrench.chinese: 我用力夺过他攥在手里的纸袋。

wring.chinese: 这件上衣湿得都能拧出水来！

wrinkle.english: Carter wrinkled his forehead in concentration.
wrinkle.chinese: 卡特全神贯注，眉头紧锁。

wrinkle.english: Alex wrinkled up her nose at the smell.
wrinkle.chinese: 闻到那股味道，亚历克丝皱起了鼻子。

wrist.english: He broke his wrist climbing rocks for a cigarette ad.
wrist.chinese: 他为了一个香烟广告攀岩折断了手腕。

writer.english: She’s one of my favourite writers.
writer.chinese: 她是我最喜欢的作家之一。

writing.english: Some of his most powerful writing is based on his childhood experiences.
writing.chinese: 他的一些最震慑人心的作品是根据儿时经历写成的。

x-ray.english: The X-ray showed that her leg was not broken.
x-ray.chinese: X光片显示她的腿没有骨折。

xerox.english: Could you xerox this letter, please?
xerox.chinese: 请复印一下这封信好吗？

yacht.english: His 36 ft yacht sank suddenly last summer.
yacht.chinese: 他的36英尺游艇去年夏天突然沉没了。

yawn.chinese: 艾伦伸伸懒腰，打了个呵欠。

yearly.english: Clients normally pay fees in advance, monthly, quarterly, or yearly.
yearly.chinese: 客户们通常提前付费，或按月，或按季度，或按年。

yearly.english: Salary levels are reviewed on a yearly basis.
yearly.chinese: 工资水平每年都要审查。

yell.english: The crowd are on their feet yelling.

yield.english: Our research has only recently begun to yield important results.
yield.chinese: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

youngster.english: Other youngsters are not so lucky.
youngster.chinese: 其他的年轻人没有这么幸运。

youth.english: Despite his youth, he had travelled alone.
youth.chinese: 他虽然年纪还小，却已独自旅行过了。

zinc.english: One medium oyster provides nearly all of the zinc you need for a day.
zinc.chinese: 一个中等大小的牡蛎几乎可以提供给你一天所需的所有锌。

zinc.english: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.

zone.english: The government has set up a special economic zone to promote private enterprise.
zone.chinese: 政府设立了一个经济特区来推动私营企业的发展。

zone.english: San Francisco and Tokyo are both located in earthquake zones.
zone.chinese: 旧金山和东京都位于地震带。
